CompressedDurationSupportPlayer.en: Supports any skill that has a duration making that duration shorter.
CompressedDurationSupportPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意有持续时间的技能，缩短持续时间。

CompressedDurationSupportPlayerTwo.en: Supports any skill that has a duration making that duration shorter.
CompressedDurationSupportPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助任意有持续时间的技能，缩短持续时间。

FistOfWarSupportPlayer.en: Supports Slams you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds.
FistOfWarSupportPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的猛击技能，每隔几秒提供强大的先祖加持。

FistOfWarSupportPlayerThree.en: Supports Slams you use yourself, providing a very powerful Ancestral Boost infrequently.
FistOfWarSupportPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的猛击技能，偶尔提供极强的先祖加持。

FistOfWarSupportPlayerTwo.en: Supports Slams you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds.
FistOfWarSupportPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的猛击技能，每隔几秒提供强大的先祖加持。

ImpactShockwaveSupportPlayer.en: Supports Melee Strike Skills and Wind Attack Skills, causing them to create an Aftershock that damages enemies around the target when they Heavy Stun an enemy.
ImpactShockwaveSupportPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助近战打击和风系攻击技能，在这些技能令敌人重度晕眩时产生余震，对目标周围的敌人造成伤害。

ProlongedDurationSupportPlayer.en: Supports any skill that has a duration, making that duration longer.
ProlongedDurationSupportPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意有持续时间的技能，延长持续时间。

ProlongedDurationSupportPlayerTwo.en: Supports any skill that has a duration, making that duration longer.
ProlongedDurationSupportPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助任意有持续时间的技能，延长持续时间。

RuthlessSupportPlayer.en: Supports Attacks, causing repeated uses to be more effective at Stunning enemies.
RuthlessSupportPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助攻击，反复使用可以更有效地令敌人晕眩。

SupportAbidingHexPlayer.en: Supports Curse Skills you cast yourself. Supported Skills will consume Power Charges on use, gaining significant Curse duration if they do. Cannot Support Skills which consume Power Charges.
SupportAbidingHexPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你自己施放的诅咒技能。被辅助技能使用时可以消耗暴击球，消耗时大幅延长诅咒的持续时间。无法辅助会消耗暴击球的技能。

SupportAcrimonyPlayer.en: Supports Skills which can Damage Enemies. Enemies affected by Damage over time from Supported Skills which was not caused by a Damaging Ailment have reduced Life regeneration rate. Only the strongest instance of this Debuff will apply. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.
SupportAcrimonyPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助能够对敌人造成伤害的技能。被辅助技能的非伤害性异常状态造成的持续伤害会使敌人的生命回复速度降低。仅有最强效的该减益状态能够生效。无法辅助召唤生物使用的技能。

SupportAddedChaosDamagePlayer.en: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Chaos Damage but deal less Damage of other Types.
SupportAddedChaosDamagePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任何造成伤害的技能，使其获得混沌伤害，但造成的其它类型伤害降低。

SupportAddedColdDamagePlayer.en: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Cold Damage but deal less Fire and Lightning Damage.
SupportAddedColdDamagePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任何造成伤害的技能，使其获得冰霜伤害，但造成的火焰与闪电伤害降低。

SupportAddedFireDamagePlayer.en: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Fire Damage but deal less Cold and Lightning Damage.
SupportAddedFireDamagePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任何造成伤害的技能，使其获得火焰伤害，但造成的冰霜与闪电伤害降低。

SupportAddedLightningDamagePlayer.en: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Lightning Damage but deal less Cold and Fire Damage.
SupportAddedLightningDamagePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任何造成伤害的技能，使其获得闪电伤害，但造成的冰霜与火焰伤害降低。

SupportAdhesiveGrenadesPlayer.en: Supports Grenade Skills. Grenades from Supported Skills do not bounce, instead halting movement where they intially land, but doing lower damage when they detonate.
SupportAdhesiveGrenadesPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助榴弹技能，被辅助技能的榴弹不会弹跳，而是停留在初始落点，引爆时造成的伤害较低。

SupportAdhesiveGrenadesPlayerTwo.en: Supports Grenade Skills. Grenades from Supported Skills do not bounce, instead halting movement where they intially land.
SupportAdhesiveGrenadesPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助榴弹技能，被辅助技能的榴弹不会弹跳，而是停留在初始落点。

SupportAdmixturePlayer.en: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Bleeding inflicted by those Hits is more effective against Poisoned Enemies, and Poison inflicted by Supported Skills is more effective against Bleeding Enemies.
SupportAdmixturePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可以造成击中伤害的技能。由这些击中造成的出血对中毒敌人更有效，而由被辅助技能造成的中毒对出血敌人更有效。

SupportAdvancingStormPlayer.en: Supports Storm skills, causing them to appear at the user's location and move towards the target location.
SupportAdvancingStormPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助风暴技能，使其从玩家处产生，并向目标位置移动。

SupportAftershockChancePlayer.en: Supports Slams you use yourself, giving them a chance to create an Aftershock.
SupportAftershockChancePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的猛击，使其有几率产生余震。

SupportAftershockChancePlayerTwo.en: Supports Slams you use yourself, giving them a chance to create an Aftershock.
SupportAftershockChancePlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的猛击，使其有几率产生余震。

SupportAhnsCitadelPlayer.en: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to instead be created along a fissure.
SupportAhnsCitadelPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生一排墙体的技能，使其改为沿着裂缝创造。

SupportAilithLineagePlayer.en: Supports Skills which can expend Combo. On expending Combo with Supported Skills, you have a chance to gain Power Charges based on the amount of Combo expended.
SupportAilithLineagePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可以消耗连击的技能。被辅助技能消耗连击时，你有机会根据消耗的连击数量获得暴击球。

SupportAlignmentPlayer.en: Supports Bow Attacks. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an Attack with Supported Skill matches that direction. Attacks from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction deal much more Damage. Cannot Support Channelled Skills.
SupportAlignmentPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助弓类的攻击。被辅助技能指示四个方向之一，被辅助技能的攻击与指示方向相同时改变指示方向。被辅助技能对指示方向的攻击会造成更高的伤害。无法辅助持续吟唱技能。

SupportAlignmentPlayerThree.en: Supports Bow Attacks. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an Attack with Supported Skill matches that direction. Attacks from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction fire additional Projectiles. Cannot Support Channelled Skills.
SupportAlignmentPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助弓类的攻击。被辅助技能指示四个方向之一，被辅助技能的攻击与指示方向相同时改变指示方向。被辅助技能与指示方向相同的攻击发射额外投射物。无法辅助持续吟唱技能。

SupportAlignmentPlayerTwo.en: Supports Bow Attacks. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an Attack with Supported Skill matches that direction. Attacks from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction deal much more Damage. Cannot Support Channelled Skills.
SupportAlignmentPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助弓类的攻击。被辅助技能指示四个方向之一，被辅助技能的攻击与指示方向相同时改变指示方向。被辅助技能对指示方向的攻击会造成更高的伤害。无法辅助持续吟唱技能。

SupportAmanamusTithePlayer.en: Supports Persistent Minion Skills, granting a chance when Supported Minions die for you to gain an Abyssal Monster Modifier.
SupportAmanamusTithePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助永久性召唤生物的技能，使被辅助的召唤生物为你而被击败后有几率获得一个深渊怪物词缀。

SupportAmbrosiaPlayer.en: Supports Skills you use yourself which damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Mana Flask charges, Gaining a percentage of damage as extra Lightning damage per Mana Flask charge consumed.
SupportAmbrosiaPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用且能够击中敌人并造成伤害的技能。被辅助技能会消耗一定比例的最大魔力药剂充能，每消耗一层魔力药剂充能就获得一定比例的额外闪电伤害。

SupportAmbrosiaPlayerTwo.en: Supports Skills you use yourself which damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Mana Flask charges, Gaining a percentage of damage as extra Lightning damage per Mana Flask charge consumed.
SupportAmbrosiaPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用且能够击中敌人并造成伤害的技能。被辅助技能会消耗一定比例的最大魔力药剂充能，每消耗一层魔力药剂充能就获得一定比例的额外闪电伤害。

SupportAmbushPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Critically Hit enemies on full life.
SupportAmbushPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其更有可能对满血的敌人造成暴击。

SupportAmmoConservationPlayer.en: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing.
SupportAmmoConservationPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助战弩弹药技能，使其射击时有几率不消耗弩箭。

SupportAmmoConservationPlayerFour.en: Supports Crossbow Skills, causing them to load a bolt into all Crossbow Ammunition on kill.
SupportAmmoConservationPlayerFour.zh_cn: 辅助战弩技能，击败敌人时为所有战弩弹药装填一发弩箭。

SupportAmmoConservationPlayerThree.en: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing, at the cost of Reload speed.
SupportAmmoConservationPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助战弩弹药技能，使其射击时有几率不消耗弩箭，但会牺牲装填速度。

SupportAmmoConservationPlayerTwo.en: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing.
SupportAmmoConservationPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助战弩弹药技能，使其射击时有几率不消耗弩箭。

SupportAncestralAidPlayer.en: Supports Strikes you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until you have Blocked a certain number of Hits, but will be Ancestrally Boosted when used. After use, this Blocked Hit counter will reset. Cannot Support Channelled Skills or Skills which already have a Condition for use.
SupportAncestralAidPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的打击技能。被辅助技能只有在你格挡一定次数的击中后才能使用，但使用时会获得先祖加持。使用后格挡计数会重置。无法辅助持续吟唱技能或存在其他使用条件的技能。

SupportAncestralCallPlayer.en: Supports Strikes you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds. Cannot Support Channelled Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.
SupportAncestralCallPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的打击技能，每隔几秒提供强大的先祖加持。无法辅助持续吟唱技能，不会修改召唤生物使用的技能。

SupportAncestralCallPlayerTwo.en: Supports Strikes you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds. Cannot Support Channelled Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.
SupportAncestralCallPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的打击技能，每隔几秒提供强大的先祖加持。无法辅助持续吟唱技能，不会修改召唤生物使用的技能。

SupportArakaalisLustPlayer.en: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to deal increasingly higher damage the more Poisons are on the target.
SupportArakaalisLustPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，目标身上中毒越多，造成的伤害越高。

SupportArbitersIgnitionPlayer.en: Supports Fire Spell Skills causing you to gain Elemental Archon when Igniting with them.
SupportArbitersIgnitionPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助火焰法术技能。用被辅助技能点燃敌人时有获得元素执政官。

SupportArcaneSurgePlayer.en: Supports Spells you cast yourself, tracking the mana you spend to cast them. Spending enough mana grants a burst of Mana Regeneration and Cast Speed.
SupportArcaneSurgePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你施放的法术，施法时会记录消耗的魔力。消耗足够的魔力可以大幅提高魔力回复和施法速度。

SupportArmourBreakPlayer.en: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Break Armour based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt.
SupportArmourBreakPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助击中敌人的技能，使击中能够粉碎护甲，相当于造成的物理伤害的一定比例。

SupportArmourBreakPlayerThree.en: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Break Armour based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt. On Fully Breaking Armour with Supported Skills, you have a chance to gain an Endurance Charge.
SupportArmourBreakPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助击中敌人的技能，使击中能够造成护甲破损，相当于造成物理伤害的一定比例。被辅助技能造成护甲完全破损时，你有几率获得一个耐力球。

SupportArmourBreakPlayerTwo.en: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Break Armour based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt. On Fully Breaking Armour with Supported Skills, you have a chance to gain an Endurance Charge.
SupportArmourBreakPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助击中敌人的技能，使击中能够造成护甲破损，相当于造成物理伤害的一定比例。被辅助技能造成护甲完全破损时，你有几率获得一个耐力球。

SupportArmourDemolisherPlayer.en: Supports any skill, causing Armour Break it inflicts to be stronger.
SupportArmourDemolisherPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意技能，使其造成的护甲破损效果更强。

SupportArmourDemolisherPlayerTwo.en: Supports any skill, causing Armour Break it inflicts to be stronger.
SupportArmourDemolisherPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助任意技能，使其造成的护甲破损效果更强。

SupportArmourExplosionPlayer.en: Supports Attacks and Warcries, causing them to trigger a Fiery explosion when they Fully Break an enemy's Armour.
SupportArmourExplosionPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助攻击和战吼，使其令敌人的护甲完全破损时触发一次烈火爆炸。

SupportArmsLengthPlayer.en: Supports Skills which Hit Enemies, causing Knockback from those Hits to be significantly more effective.
SupportArmsLengthPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助击中敌人的技能，使击中产生的击退效果大幅提高。

SupportAstralProjectionPlayer.en: Supports Nova Skills, causing those Skills to take place at the targeted location when used instead of around you.
SupportAstralProjectionPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助新星技能，使用这些技能时不再在你的周围生效，改为在目标位置生效。

SupportAtaluiBloodlettingPlayer.en: Supports any Skill, turning a portion of its Mana cost into a Life cost. Does not support Skills which reserve Spirit. Supported Skills Gain a portion of their Life cost as extra Physical Damage.
SupportAtaluiBloodlettingPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意技能，将部分魔力消耗转换为生命消耗。无法辅助保留精魂的技能。被辅助技能获得相当于部分生命消耗的额外物理伤害。

SupportAtzirisAllurePlayer.en: Supports Curse Spells you cast yourself, causing those Curses to ignore the usual Curse Limit, but be reflected back to you when inflicted.
SupportAtzirisAllurePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你释放的诅咒法术技能，使这些诅咒突破通常的诅咒上限，但施放时会将效果反弹至你自身。

SupportAtzirisCommunionPlayer.en: Supports Persistent Skills, making them Reserve Life instead of Spirit. Cannot Support Skills which create Minions.
SupportAtzirisCommunionPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助永久性技能，使其改为保留生命而非精魂。无法辅助产生召唤生物的技能。

SupportAtzirisImpatiencePlayer.en: Supports Skills you use yourself that have Cooldowns, dramatically increasing the rate at which those Cooldowns Recover, but causing you to lose Life, Mana, and Energy Shield when they are used. Cannot Support Meta Skills or Persistent Skills, or modify the Skills of Minions.
SupportAtzirisImpatiencePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助拥有冷却时间的技能，大幅提升其冷却回复速度，但使用时会消耗你的生命、魔力与能量护盾。无法辅助非凡技能、永久性技能或影响召唤生物的技能。

SupportAutoReloadPlayer.en: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to automatically reload when they Heavy Stun an enemy.
SupportAutoReloadPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助战弩弹药技能，使其令敌人重度晕眩时自动装填。

SupportBarbsPlayer.en: Supports Melee Strike Skills. After you Retaliate with Thorns Damage, you also deal your Thorns damage to enemies you Hit with Supported Skills.
SupportBarbsPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助近战打击技能。当你用荆棘伤害进行反击后，你同时会对被辅助技能击中的敌人造成你的荆棘伤害。

SupportBarbsPlayerThree.en: Supports Melee Strike Skills. After you Retaliate with Thorns Damage, you also deal your Thorns damage twice to enemies you Hit with Supported Skills.
SupportBarbsPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助近战打击技能。当你用荆棘伤害进行反击后，你会对被辅助技能击中的敌人造成两次你的荆棘伤害。

SupportBarbsPlayerTwo.en: Supports Melee Strike Skills. After you Retaliate with Thorns Damage, you also deal your Thorns damage to enemies you Hit with Supported Skills.
SupportBarbsPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助近战打击技能。当你用荆棘伤害进行反击后，你同时会对被辅助技能击中的敌人造成你的荆棘伤害。

SupportBattershoutPlayer.en: Supports Warcry Skills. Supported Skills Consume Fully Broken Armour to trigger Physical Damage explosions on Enemies within their range but cannot themselves Break Armour.
SupportBattershoutPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助战吼技能。被辅助技能消耗范围内敌人的护甲完全破损以触发物理伤害爆炸，但本身无法粉碎护甲。

SupportBeheadPlayer.en: Supports Strike skills, causing them to steal a Modifier from Rare monsters they kill.
SupportBeheadPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助打击技能，使其从击败的稀有敌人处窃取一个词缀。

SupportBeheadPlayerTwo.en: Supports Strike skills, causing them to steal two Modifiers from Rare monsters they kill.
SupportBeheadPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助打击技能，使其从击败的稀有敌人处窃取两个词缀。

SupportBhatairsVengeancePlayer.en: Supports Attacks and Warcries you use yourself. Freezing an enemy with Supported Skills infuses you and your allies with Cold damage for a short time.
SupportBhatairsVengeancePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的攻击和战吼。使用被辅助技能冻结敌人后，你和友军在短时间内附加冰霜伤害。

SupportBiddingPlayer.en: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions deal more damage and have increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.
SupportBiddingPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助召唤生物技能，被辅助的召唤生物造成更高的伤害，命令技能的冷却回复速度提高。

SupportBiddingPlayerThree.en: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions have significantly increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.
SupportBiddingPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助召唤生物技能，被辅助的召唤生物命令技能的冷却回复速度大幅提高。

SupportBiddingPlayerTwo.en: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions deal more damage and have increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.
SupportBiddingPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助召唤生物技能，被辅助的召唤生物造成更高的伤害，命令技能的冷却回复速度提高。

SupportBitingFrostPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more damage to Frozen enemies but consume their Freeze. Cannot support skills that Consume Freeze.
SupportBitingFrostPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其对冻结的敌人造成更高的伤害，但会消耗敌人身上的冻结。无法辅助消耗冻结的技能。

SupportBitingFrostPlayerTwo.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more damage to Frozen enemies but consume their Freeze, leaving them Chilled. Cannot support skills that Consume Freeze.
SupportBitingFrostPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其对冻结的敌人造成更高的伤害，但会消耗敌人身上的冻结，使其被冰缓。无法辅助消耗冻结的技能。

SupportBlazingCriticalPlayer.en: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Critical Hits with Supported Skills imbue all of your Attacks with Fire damage for a duration.
SupportBlazingCriticalPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的可击中敌人的技能。使用被辅助的技能造成暴击后，会在持续一段时间内为你所有的攻击附加火焰伤害。

SupportBleedPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to inflict Bleeding.
SupportBleedPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其有几率造成流血。

SupportBleedPlayerFour.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more Melee Physical Damage to Bleeding Enemies, but be unable to inflict Bleeding itself. Supported Skills also inflict Incision on Hit.
SupportBleedPlayerFour.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，对流血敌人造成更多近战物理伤害，但自身无法施加流血。被辅助技能击中时也会施加创口。

SupportBleedPlayerThree.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Bleeding.
SupportBleedPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其施加流血。

SupportBleedPlayerTwo.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to inflict Bleeding.
SupportBleedPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其有几率造成流血。

SupportBlindPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to Blind on Hit.
SupportBlindPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使击中能造成致盲。

SupportBlindPlayerTwo.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to Blind on Hit with increased effect.
SupportBlindPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，击中时施加增强的致盲效果。

SupportBlindsidePlayer.en: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills are more likely to Critically Hit Blinded Enemies, and deal more Damage with Critical Hits against Blinded Enemies, but cannot themselves inflict Blind.
SupportBlindsidePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助造成伤害性击中的技能。被辅助技能更有可能对被致盲的敌人造成暴击，对被致盲的敌人造成的暴击伤害提高，但其本身无法造成致盲。

SupportBloodFountainPlayer.en: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by supported Skills generate a Font of Blood which will Leech Life to Allies within it.
SupportBloodFountainPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生图腾的技能。被辅助技能产生的图腾生成血脉源泉，为范围内的友军偷取生命。

SupportBloodMagicPlayer.en: Supports any Skill, turning its Mana cost into a Life cost. Does not support Skills which reserve Spirit.
SupportBloodMagicPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意技能，将其魔力消耗转换为生命消耗。无法辅助保留精魄的技能。

SupportBloodlustPlayer.en: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to deal more damage against Bleeding enemies, but preventing them from inflicting Bleeding.
SupportBloodlustPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助近战攻击，使该技能对流血敌人造成更高伤害，但无施加流血。

SupportBoneShrapnelPlayer.en: Supports Skills which Hit Enemies. Supported Skills trigger Bone Shrapnel explosions when killing Pinned Enemies.
SupportBoneShrapnelPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助击中敌人的技能。被辅助技能击败定身的敌人时触发钙质碎片爆破。

SupportBoundlessEnergyPlayer.en: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills generate Energy significantly faster.
SupportBoundlessEnergyPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助非凡技能。被辅助技能产生能量的速度大幅加快。

SupportBoundlessEnergyPlayerTwo.en: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills generate Energy significantly faster.
SupportBoundlessEnergyPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助非凡技能。被辅助技能产生能量的速度大幅加快。

SupportBountyPlayer.en: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing Enemies it kills to grant more Flask and Charm charges.
SupportBountyPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其击败的敌人提供更多药剂和咒符充能。

SupportBountyPlayerTwo.en: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing Enemies it kills to grant more Flask and Charm charges.
SupportBountyPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其击败的敌人提供更多药剂和咒符充能。

SupportBranchingFissuresPlayer.en: Supports Skills which create Fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional secondary Fissures which branch off from the primary fissure, with lowered area of effect and Damage.
SupportBranchingFissuresPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助在地上产生裂缝的技能，使其产生额外的次级裂缝。次级裂缝从主裂缝分支出来，效果范围和伤害降低。

SupportBranchingFissuresPlayerTwo.en: Supports Skills which create Fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional secondary Fissures which branch off from the primary fissure, with lowered area of effect and Damage.
SupportBranchingFissuresPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助在地上产生裂缝的技能，使其产生额外的次级裂缝。次级裂缝从主裂缝分支出来，效果范围和伤害降低。

SupportBrinkPlayer.en: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills build up Heavy Stun more quickly, but cannot themselves Heavy Stun.
SupportBrinkPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助近战攻击技能。被辅助技能积蓄重度晕眩的速度更快，但其本身无法造成重度晕眩。

SupportBrinkPlayerTwo.en: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills build up Stun more quickly, but cannot themselves Stun.
SupportBrinkPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助近战攻击技能。被辅助技能积蓄晕眩的速度更快，但其本身无法造成晕眩。

SupportBrittleArmourPlayer.en: Supports Skills which can Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills which Freeze enemies cause Physical damage against them to Break their Armour while they remain Frozen.
SupportBrittleArmourPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可击中敌人的技能。若使用被辅助技能击中，从而使敌人冻结，在其保持冻结状态期间，对其造成的物理伤害会造成护甲破损。

SupportBrutalityPlayer.en: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types.
SupportBrutalityPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意可以造成伤害的技能，使其牺牲其它类型伤害，提高物理伤害。

SupportBrutalityPlayerThree.en: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types, as well as giving Hits from that skill a chance to ignore Physical Damage reduction.
SupportBrutalityPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助任意造成伤害的技能，牺牲其他伤害类型来提高物理伤害，并使该技能的击中有几率无视物理伤害减免。

SupportBrutalityPlayerTwo.en: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types.
SupportBrutalityPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助任意可以造成伤害的技能，使其牺牲其它类型伤害，提高物理伤害。

SupportBrutusBrainPlayer.en: Supports skills which create Minions, causing those Minions to be unable to deal or take Damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.
SupportBrutusBrainPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生召唤生物的技能，使这些召唤生物无法造成或承受伤害。无法辅助产生无敌召唤生物的技能。

SupportBurgeonPlayer.en: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, causing them to deal more damage the longer they have been Channelled.
SupportBurgeonPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用的持续吟唱技能，使其吟唱的时间越久，造成的伤害越高。

SupportBurgeonPlayerTwo.en: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, causing them to deal more damage the longer they have been Channelled.
SupportBurgeonPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用的持续吟唱技能，使其吟唱的时间越久，造成的伤害越高。

SupportBurningRunesPlayer.en: Supports any Skill which creates Runic Inscriptions when Cast, causing those Runic Inscriptions to trigger Burning Inscription when they expire. Burning Inscription is a Spell which creates Ignited Ground based off of your Maximum Mana.
SupportBurningRunesPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意施放时产生铭刻符文的技能，使铭刻符文效果结束时产生燃烧铭文。燃烧铭文属于法术，会根据你的魔力上限造成点燃地面。

SupportBurstingPlaguePlayer.en: Supports skills that can Poison enemies, causing Poisoned enemies to gain Plague over time and explode in a Plague Burst on death. Cannot support the skills of Minions.
SupportBurstingPlaguePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助使敌人中毒的技能，使中毒的敌人持续受到顽疾影响，并且在被击败时造成毒爆发。无法辅助召唤生物的技能。

SupportCadencePlayer.en: Supports Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills gain more Attack speed each time you use them, but will become unusable if used too frequently in a short time frame. Sustained Skills will instead gain Attack speed periodically while being used.
SupportCadencePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的攻击。被辅助技能每次使用都会提高攻击速度，但在短时间内使用过多就会无法使用。若为持续性技能，则在使用期间会定期获得攻击速度提升。

SupportCaltropsPlayer.en: Supports Ranged Spear Attacks. Supported Skills create Caltrops when Projectiles they create reach the end of their flight.
SupportCaltropsPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助远程战矛攻击。被辅助技能的投射物结束飞行时产生铁蒺藜。

SupportCannibalismPlayer.en: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to recover Life on kill while the Skill is active.
SupportCannibalismPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助永久性增益技能，激活该技能时击败敌人可为你回复生命。

SupportCannibalismPlayerTwo.en: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to recover Life on kill while the Skill is active.
SupportCannibalismPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助永久性增益技能，激活该技能时击败敌人可为你回复生命。

SupportCatalysingElementsPlayer.en: Supports Skills which are boosted by Elemental Ground Surfaces, Triggering Catalysing Discharge of the corresponding type when they are boosted by an allied Elemental Ground Surface.
SupportCatalysingElementsPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助那些可通过元素地面效果获得强化的技能。当它们因友方创造的元素地面效果而获得强化时，将触发相应类型的催化迸放效果。

SupportCatharsisPlayer.en: Supports any Skill you use yourself, causing supported Skill to detonate Volatility that is present on you. Supported Skill can only be used while you have a certain amount of Volatility and cannot support Skills which already have another Condition.
SupportCatharsisPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的任意技能，使被辅助技能引爆你当前具有的无常。被辅助技能只能在你具有一定数量的无常后使用，无法辅助已有其他条件的技能。

SupportChainPlayer.en: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.
SupportChainPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助投射物技能和任意能够连锁的技能，使其能够额外连锁多次。

SupportChainPlayerThree.en: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.
SupportChainPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助投射物技能和任意能够连锁的技能，使其能够额外连锁多次。

SupportChainPlayerTwo.en: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.
SupportChainPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助投射物技能和任意能够连锁的技能，使其能够额外连锁多次。

SupportChaosMasteryPlayer.en: Supports Chaos skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
SupportChaosMasteryPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助混沌技能，使其等级提升一级。不能辅助没有等级的技能。

SupportChaoticFreezePlayer.en: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment Chaos damage over time. Enemies taking damage over time from Debuffs caused by supported skills will suffer Freeze build up from Chaos damage Hits from any source. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.
SupportChaoticFreezePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助造成非异常状态的混沌持续伤害的法术。敌人受到被辅助技能的减益持续伤害时，从所有来源受到的击中混沌伤害都会产生冻结积蓄值。无法辅助召唤生物使用的技能。

SupportChargeInhibitionPlayer.en: Supports any Skill you use or Trigger yourself. Supported Skills cannot consume Charges or Infusion by any means. Cannot Support Skills which require Charges or Infusion to be used.
SupportChargeInhibitionPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用或你自己触发的技能。被辅助技能无法以任何方式消耗能量球或灌注。无法辅助需要消耗能量球或灌注才能使用的技能。

SupportChargeProfusionPlayer.en: Supports skills that can generate Charges, giving them a chance to generate an additional Charge when they do so.
SupportChargeProfusionPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助生成能量球的技能，使其在生成能量球时有几率额外生成一个。

SupportChargeProfusionPlayerTwo.en: Supports skills that can generate Charges, giving them a chance to generate an additional Charge when they do so, as well as a chance to generate an additional Charge of a random type.
SupportChargeProfusionPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助生成能量球的技能，使其在生成能量球时有几率额外生成一个，并有几率额外产生一个随机类型的能量球。

SupportChargedMarkPlayer.en: Supports Mark Skills, causing them to Trigger Charged Mark when they are Activated. Charged Mark creates Shocked Ground at the target's location.
SupportChargedMarkPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助印记技能，使其激活时触发充能印记。充能印记会在目标位置生成感电地面。

SupportChargedShotsPlayer.en: Supports Bow Attacks. Every third shot with Supported Skills restores a portion of its Mana cost and Gains Damage as extra Lightning Damage.
SupportChargedShotsPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助弓类攻击。每当第三次使用被辅助技能进行射击时,会恢复一定比例的魔力消耗，并使造成的伤害获得额外的闪电伤害.

SupportChargedShotsPlayerTwo.en: Supports Bow Attacks. Every third shot with Supported Skills Gains Damage as extra Lightning Damage.
SupportChargedShotsPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助弓类攻击。被辅助技能的每第三次射击获得额外闪电伤害。

SupportCharmBountyPlayer.en: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing Enemies it kills to grant more Charm charges.
SupportCharmBountyPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其击败敌人后获得更多的咒符充能。

SupportChillingIcePlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to create patches of Chilled Ground around Frozen enemies.
SupportChillingIcePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，在被冻结的敌人周围产生冰缓地面。

SupportCirelsCultivationPlayer.en: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing you from having more than one of that Totem but granting significant benefits for Supported Totems based how many allied Totems are near them. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.
SupportCirelsCultivationPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可创建图腾的技能，但仅允许拥有一个该种图腾，但会依据周围友军拥有的图腾数量，为被辅助的图腾提供显著增益。无法辅助由召唤生物施放的技能。

SupportClarityPlayer.en: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Mana Regeneration while the Skill is active.
SupportClarityPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助永久性增益技能，激活该技能时提高你的魔力回复速度。

SupportClarityPlayerTwo.en: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Mana Regeneration while the Skill is active.
SupportClarityPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助永久性增益技能，激活该技能时提高你的魔力回复速度。

SupportClashPlayer.en: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills deal more Damage while you have a lower percentage of your Life remaining than the target struck, but less Damage when the reverse is true.
SupportClashPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助近战攻击技能。当你的剩余生命比例低于击中的目标时，被辅助技能会造成更高的伤害，但反之会造成更低的伤害。

SupportCloseCombatPlayer.en: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage to enemies based on how close they are to you.
SupportCloseCombatPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助攻击，敌人距离你越近，攻击对敌人造成的伤害越高。

SupportCloseCombatPlayerTwo.en: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage to enemies based on how close they are to you.
SupportCloseCombatPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助攻击，敌人距离你越近，攻击对敌人造成的伤害越高。

SupportColdMasteryPlayer.en: Supports Cold skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
SupportColdMasteryPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助冰霜技能，使其等级提升一级。不能辅助没有等级的技能。

SupportColdPenetrationPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Cold resistance.
SupportColdPenetrationPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使击中能穿透敌人的冰霜抗性。

SupportCombatReloadPlayer.en: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load multiple extra bolts and attack faster. Supported Skills cannot reload normally, instead loading bolts when you Dodge.
SupportCombatReloadPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助战弩弹药技能，使其装填多发额外弩箭并提升击发速度。被辅助技能无法正常装填，改为在闪避时进行装填。

SupportComboFinisherPlayer.en: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until enough Combo has been built up, but deal more damage. Cannot support skills which already Combo.
SupportComboFinisherPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的近战攻击。被辅助技能只有在积累足够的连击后才能使用，但造成的伤害提高。无法辅助本身属于连击的技能。

SupportComboFinisherPlayerTwo.en: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until enough Combo has been built up, but deal massively more damage. Cannot support skills which already Combo.
SupportComboFinisherPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的近战攻击。被辅助技能只有在积累足够的连击后才能使用，但造成的伤害大幅提高。无法辅助本身属于连击的技能。

SupportCommandment.en: Supports Minions which have Command Skills. Supported Minions have massively increased cooldown recovery speed for Command Skills they use, but deal no damage with non-Command Skills.
SupportCommandment.zh_cn: 辅助具有命令技能的召唤生物。被辅助的召唤生物的命令技能冷却回复速度大幅加快，但是非命令技能无法造成伤害。

SupportCommiseratePlayer.en: Supports Skills you use or Trigger yourself, which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills inflict more powerful Ailments if you are afflicted with those Ailments when you inflict them, while also removing from you any Ailment that they inflict.
SupportCommiseratePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用或自己触发的造成伤害性击中的技能。当你受到异常状态影响时，被辅助技能造成的同类异常状态更为强大，并且会移除你受到的同类异常状态。

SupportConcentratedAreaPlayer.en: Supports any skill with an area of effect, causing that area to be smaller but any area damage it deals to be higher.
SupportConcentratedAreaPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意有范围效果的技能，使技能的效果范围变小，但造成更高的范围伤害。

SupportConcoctPlayer.en: Supports Skills you use yourself which Damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Life Flask charges, inflicting more powerful Bleeding based on Life Flask charges consumed.
SupportConcoctPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用且能够击中敌人并造成伤害的技能。被辅助技能会消耗一定比例的最大生命药剂充能，根据消耗的生命药剂充能造成更强的流血效果。

SupportConcoctPlayerTwo.en: Supports Skills you use yourself which Damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Life Flask charges, inflicting more powerful Bleeding based on Life Flask charges consumed.
SupportConcoctPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用且能够击中敌人并造成伤害的技能。被辅助技能会消耗一定比例的最大生命药剂充能，根据消耗的生命药剂充能造成更强的流血效果。

SupportConcussiveSpellsPlayer.en: Supports Spells which Hit enemies. Supported Skills Daze on Critically Hitting enemies with Physical damage.
SupportConcussiveSpellsPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可击中敌人的法术。被辅助的技能若以物理伤害对敌人造成暴击，则会使其恍惚。

SupportConsideredCastingPlayer.en: Supports Spell Skills that Hit Enemies and you cast yourself, boosting Damage at the cost of Cast Speed.
SupportConsideredCastingPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你自己施放的击中敌人的法术技能，增强伤害但牺牲施法速度。

SupportControlledDestructionPlayer.en: Supports Spells that Hit enemies, boosting their damage but preventing them from dealing Critical Hits.
SupportControlledDestructionPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助击中敌人的法术，大幅提升伤害，但无法造成暴击。

SupportControlledHazardPlayer.en: Supports Skills which create Hazards, causing those Hazards to be unable to be triggered for 3 seconds after being created.
SupportControlledHazardPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生危害的技能，使这些危害在生成后的 3 秒内无法被触发。

SupportCooldownRecoveryPlayer.en: Supports skills with Cooldowns, increasing the rate at which those Cooldowns Recover. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
SupportCooldownRecoveryPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助有冷却时间的技能，加快冷却回复速度。不能调整召唤生物技能。

SupportCooldownRecoveryPlayerTwo.en: Supports skills with Cooldowns, increasing the rate at which those Cooldowns Recover. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
SupportCooldownRecoveryPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助有冷却时间的技能，加快冷却回复速度。不能调整召唤生物技能。

SupportCoolheadedPlayer.en: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Ignite applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.
SupportCoolheadedPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助永久性增益状态技能，激活被辅助技能时，缩短对你施加的点燃的持续时间。

SupportCorpseConservationPlayer.en: Supports skills that consume Corpses, giving them a chance to take effect without destroying the Corpse.
SupportCorpseConservationPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助消耗灵柩的技能，使其有几率在产生效果时不摧毁灵柩。

SupportCorrosionPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing Poison it applies to also Break enemy Armour. Cannot support skills that Consume Fully Broken Armour.
SupportCorrosionPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其在对敌人施加中毒效果的同时造成护甲破损。无法辅助消耗护甲完全破损的技能。

SupportCorruptingCryPlayer.en: Supports Warcries, Triggering Corrupted Cry to inflict Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect.
SupportCorruptingCryPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助战吼技能，触发腐化战吼，对其效果范围内的敌人施加腐化之血。

SupportCorruptingCryPlayerThree.en: Supports Warcries, Triggering Twisted Pact  to inflict Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect., at the cost of your Life.
SupportCorruptingCryPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助战吼技能，触发腐化战吼，消耗生命，对其效果范围内的敌人施加腐化之血。

SupportCorruptingCryPlayerTwo.en: Supports Warcries, Triggering Corrupted Cry to inflict Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect.
SupportCorruptingCryPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助战吼技能，触发腐化战吼，对其效果范围内的敌人施加腐化之血。

SupportCracklingBarrierPlayer.en: Supports Channelling Skills. While Channelling Supported Skills, you gain Lightning Thorns based off of your maximum Mana.
SupportCracklingBarrierPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助持续吟唱技能。在吟唱被辅助技能时，你会根据魔力上限获得闪电荆棘。

SupportCraterPlayer.en: Supports Melee Skills that leap into the air, causing them to create Fissures when you land. Cannot Support Totem Skills, and does not modify Skills used by Minions.
SupportCraterPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助跃入空中的近战技能，使其落地时产生裂缝。无法辅助图腾技能，不会修改召唤生物使用的技能。

SupportCrazedMinionsPlayer.en: Supports Minion Skills which summon Reviving Minions. Supported Minions deal significantly more Damage if they have Revived Recently.
SupportCrazedMinionsPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助能够召唤可复活的召唤生物的召唤生物技能。被辅助的召唤生物若近期复活过，则造成的伤害大幅提高。

SupportCreepingChillPlayer.en: Supports any Skill that creates Ice Crystals, causing that Skill to Consume a Power Charge if possible to create Chilled Ground around the Crystal.
SupportCreepingChillPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助生成冰晶的技能，若有可能，该技能将消耗一个暴击球以在冰晶周围生成冰缓地面。

SupportCrescendoPlayer.en: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, allowing you to use the Final Strike twice in succession.
SupportCrescendoPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助在组合攻击的最后发动绝杀打击的打击，使你可以连续使用两次绝杀打击。

SupportCrescendoPlayerThree.en: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, causing the Final Strike to be Ancestrally Boosted.
SupportCrescendoPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助在组合攻击最后进行绝杀打击的打击，使绝杀打击获得先祖加持。

SupportCrescendoPlayerTwo.en: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, allowing you to use the Final Strike twice in succession, and causing Non-Final Strike Attacks to be faster.
SupportCrescendoPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助在组合攻击的最后发动绝杀打击的打击，使你可以连续使用两次绝杀打击，并使非绝杀打击攻击速度更快。

SupportCrystallineShardsPlayer.en: Supports Skills which create Ice Crystals. Damaging Explosions caused by Ice Crystals from Supported Skills will Impale Enemies.
SupportCrystallineShardsPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生冰晶的技能。被辅助技能的冰晶造成的伤害性爆炸会穿刺敌人。

SupportCullingStrikePlayer.en: Supports Attack Skills, causing them to Cull Rare and Unique Enemies on Hit.
SupportCullingStrikePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助攻击技能，使攻击击中时终结稀有和传奇敌人。

SupportCullingStrikePlayerTwo.en: Supports Attack Skills, causing them to Cull Rare and Unique Enemies on Hit, and increasing the threshold at which they will Cull Enemies.
SupportCullingStrikePlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助攻击技能，使其击中时终结稀有和传奇敌人，并提高终结敌人的阈值。

SupportCulminationPlayer.en: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills gain Combo when you successfully Strike Enemies with other Melee Attacks. Supported Skills reset their Combo on use, dealing more Damage the higher Combo you had on use. Cannot support skills which already gain Combo. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.
SupportCulminationPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助近战攻击技能。使用其他近战攻击成功打击敌人会使被辅助技能获得连击。使用被辅助技能时重置连击，使用时具有的连击越高，造成的伤害越高。无法辅助本身获得连击的技能。无法修改召唤生物使用的技能。

SupportCulminationPlayerTwo.en: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills gain Combo when you successfully Strike Enemies with other Melee Attacks. Supported Skills reset their Combo on use, dealing more Damage the higher Combo you had on use. Cannot support skills which already gain Combo. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.
SupportCulminationPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助近战攻击技能。使用其他近战攻击成功打击敌人会使被辅助技能获得连击。使用被辅助技能时重置连击，使用时具有的连击越高，造成的伤害越高。无法辅助本身获得连击的技能。无法修改召唤生物使用的技能。

SupportCurseEffectPlayer.en: Supports Curse Skills, magnifying their power.
SupportCurseEffectPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助诅咒技能，强化其力量。

SupportCursedGroundPlayer.en: Supports Curse Skills. Supported Curse Skills create areas which Curse Enemies so long as they are within them.
SupportCursedGroundPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助诅咒技能，被辅助的诅咒技能产生一片区域，持续对其中的敌人施加诅咒。

SupportDanseMacabrePlayer.en: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills have increased Buff effect and deal more damage, but will target an additional skeletal Minion when cast. If there is not an additional skeletal Minion to target, no damage or Buff effect will be granted.
SupportDanseMacabrePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助奉献技能。被辅助技能的增益状态效果提高，造成更高的伤害，但施放时会额外以一个魔侍召唤生物为目标。如果没有额外的魔侍召唤生物，则不会提高伤害或增益状态效果。

SupportDaressosPassionPlayer.en: Supports Banner Skills, causing them to require significantly less Glory to use.
SupportDaressosPassionPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助旗帜技能，使其需要的荣耀大幅降低。

SupportDauntlessPlayer.en: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills cannot be used unless you have been stationary for a certain duration, but deal increasingly more damage the longer you are stationary. Cannot support Skills which have a cooldown or another usage Condition.
SupportDauntlessPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用的造成伤害性击中的技能。被辅助技能只有在你静止不动一段时间后才能使用，但静止的时间越长，造成的伤害越高。无法辅助具有冷却时间的技能或存在其他使用条件的技能。

SupportDazePlayer.en: Supports Attacks, causing them to build up Daze based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt.
SupportDazePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助攻击，使其造成恍惚积蓄值，相当于造成的物理伤害的一定比例。

SupportDeadlyCurrentPlayer.en: Supports Skills which Hit enemies. Shocking an enemy with Supported Skills Triggers Coursing Current, which sends Chaining Lightning Projectiles to nearby Drenched enemies.
SupportDeadlyCurrentPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可击中敌人的技能。使用被辅助的技能感电敌人会触发奔雷疾走，向附近处于浸湿状态的敌人发射连锁的闪电投射物。

SupportDeadlyHeraldsPlayer.en: Supports Herald Skills, making their triggered effects deal more damage at the expense of higher Spirit cost.
SupportDeadlyHeraldsPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助捷技能，使其触发效果造成更高伤害，但提高精魂成本。

SupportDeadlyIgnitesPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing inflicted Ignites to deal more damage but its Hits to deal less damage.
SupportDeadlyIgnitesPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其造成的点燃伤害提高，但击中的伤害降低。

SupportDeadlyIgnitesPlayerTwo.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing inflicted Ignites to deal more damage but its Hits to deal less damage.
SupportDeadlyIgnitesPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其造成的点燃伤害提高，但击中的伤害降低。

SupportDeadlyPoisonPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Poison.
SupportDeadlyPoisonPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其造成的伤害降低，但造成更强的中毒效果。

SupportDeadlyPoisonPlayerTwo.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Poison.
SupportDeadlyPoisonPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其造成的伤害降低，但造成更强的中毒效果。

SupportDeadlyResolvePlayer.en: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself. While Channelling Supported Skills, periodically gain stages of Deadly Resolve. Expend a stage of Deadly Resolve when an enemy Hits you to Trigger a deadly slash towards that enemy, dealing more damage based on your Armour.
SupportDeadlyResolvePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的持续吟唱技能。在持续吟唱被辅助技能时，会周期性获得致命决心层数，之后当你被击中时，消耗一层致命决心，触发一次致命的斩击，造成的伤害会基于你的护甲提高。

SupportDeathmarchPlayer.en: Supports Skills which create Persistent Minions. Supported Minions will restore Life to nearby Allied Minions on death, as well as removing Ailments from those Minions.
SupportDeathmarchPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助能够产生永久性召唤生物的技能。被辅助的召唤生物被击败时使附近的友军召唤生物回复生命，并移除这些召唤生物受到的异常状态。

SupportDecayingHexPlayer.en: Supports Curse skills. Supported skill Trigger Profane Decay on each target they curse to inflict a damaging Debuff.
SupportDecayingHexPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助诅咒技能，被辅助技能每次诅咒一个目标时，会触发亵渎朽坏，对其施加造成伤害的减益状态。

SupportDeepCutsPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Bleeding.
SupportDeepCutsPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其造成的伤害降低，但造成更强的流血效果。

SupportDeepCutsPlayerTwo.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Bleeding.
SupportDeepCutsPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其造成的伤害降低，但造成更强的流血效果。

SupportDefyPlayer.en: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Hit Damage from Supported Skills is Lucky if you are Surrounded.
SupportDefyPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的攻击技能。如果你被被包围，被辅助技能的击中伤害特别幸运。

SupportDefyPlayerTwo.en: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Hit Damage from Supported Skills is Lucky and Insufficient Mana doesn't prevent Supported Skills from being used if you are Surrounded.
SupportDefyPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的攻击技能。如果你被包围，被辅助技能的击中伤害特别幸运，魔力不足不会阻止被辅助技能的使用。

SupportDelayedGratificationPlayer.en: Supports Skills which require some Condition to be met for use. Supported Skills can be used an additional time after their Condition has been met, but meeting that Condition is harder.
SupportDelayedGratificationPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助需要满足条件才能使用的技能。被辅助技能满足条件后可以额外使用一次，但条件会更难满足。

SupportDelayedReactionPlayer.en: Supports Skills which create Hazards, causing those Hazards to only be able to trigger immediately after creation or at the end of their duration. Created Hazards have significantly lowered duration, and deal more damage.
SupportDelayedReactionPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生危害的技能，使危害只能在产生后立即触发或在持续时间结束时触发。产生的危害持续时间大幅缩短，并且造成更高的伤害。

SupportDeliberationPlayer.en: Supports skills that can be used while moving, causing you to move slower while using them, but granting more damage in exchange.
SupportDeliberationPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可在移动时使用的技能，使你在使用技能时移动速度减慢，同时提高伤害。

SupportDerangePlayer.en: Supports Skills which you use yourself which can deal damage. Supported Skills gain an Energy Shield cost equal to your Intelligence, while also dealing more non-Ailment Damage over time based off of your Intelligence. Cannot support Channelling Skills.
SupportDerangePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用的能够造成伤害的技能。被辅助技能获得等同于你的智慧的能量护盾消耗，同时会根据你的智慧造成更高的非异常状态的持续伤害。无法辅助持续吟唱技能。

SupportDiallasDesirePlayer.en: Supports any Skill which has levels, increasing the level and Quality, while reducing the cost and Reservation.
SupportDiallasDesirePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任何有等级的技能，提高等级和品质，同时降低消耗和保留。

SupportDirestrikePlayer.en: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Attack Damage while on Low Life while the Supported Skill is active.
SupportDirestrikePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助永久性增益状态技能，激活被辅助技能且低血时，提高你造成的攻击伤害。

SupportDirestrikePlayerTwo.en: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Attack Damage while on Low Life while the Supported Skill is active.
SupportDirestrikePlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助永久性增益状态技能，激活被辅助技能且低血时，提高你造成的攻击伤害。

SupportDoubleBarrelPlayer.en: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed.
SupportDoubleBarrelPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助战弩弹药技能，使其额外装填一发弩箭，但会牺牲装填速度。

SupportDoubleBarrelPlayerThree.en: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed. Supported Skills will also automatically reload when they Heavy Stun an enemy.
SupportDoubleBarrelPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助战弩弹药技能，使其额外装填一发弩箭，但会牺牲装填速度。辅助的技能还会在使敌人重度晕眩时自动装填。

SupportDoubleBarrelPlayerTwo.en: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed.
SupportDoubleBarrelPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助战弩弹药技能，使其额外装填一发弩箭，但会牺牲装填速度。

SupportDrainedAilmentPlayer.en: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment damage over time, causing them to consume Ailments on enemies it applies damage over time Debuffs to in order to deal substantially more damage over time.
SupportDrainedAilmentPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助造成非异常状态的持续伤害的法术，使其施加持续伤害减益时消耗敌人受到的异常状态，从而大幅提高持续伤害。

SupportDurabilityPlayer.en: Supports Skills which create objects that are destroyed after being Hit a number of times, allowing for them to last for additional Hits. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.
SupportDurabilityPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生被击中一定次数后被破坏的物体的技能，使其可以承受额外次数的击中。不会修改召唤生物使用的技能。

SupportEchoingCryPlayer.en: Supports Warcries. Supported Skills Echo twice, and their area grows larger each time, but are less effective and require you to have travelled a certain distance before use.
SupportEchoingCryPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助战吼类技能。被辅助技能会回响 2 次，每次范围扩大，但效果降低，并且需要你在使用前移动一定距离。

SupportEfficiencyPlayer.en: Supports any skill, making it cost less to use. Cannot support skills which reserve Spirit.
SupportEfficiencyPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意技能，降低使用技能的消耗。无法辅助保留精魂的技能。

SupportEfficiencyPlayerTwo.en: Supports any skill, making it cost less to use. Cannot support skills which reserve Spirit.
SupportEfficiencyPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助任意技能，降低使用技能的消耗。无法辅助保留精魂的技能。

SupportEinharsBeastritePlayer.en: Supports Melee Strike skills, causing them to steal a Modifier from Rare monsters they kill for a lengthy duration, while being unable to damage enemies not on low Life. Does not modify skills used by Minions.
SupportEinharsBeastritePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助近战打击技能，使其从击败的稀有怪物处窃取一个词缀，持续时间较长，但无法对非低血敌人造成伤害。无法修改召唤生物使用的技能。

SupportElectrocutePlayer.en: Supports any Skill which can deal Damage. Lightning Damage from Supported Skills can inflict Electrocute, but Supported Skills cannot inflict Shock.
SupportElectrocutePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意造成伤害的技能。被辅助技能的闪电伤害可以造成触电，但被辅助技能无法施加感电。

SupportElementalArmamentPlayer.en: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more Elemental damage.
SupportElementalArmamentPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助攻击，使攻击造成更高元素伤害。

SupportElementalArmamentPlayerThree.en: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more Damage for each Elemental Ailment on Enemies they Hit. Supported Skills cannot themselves inflict Elemental Ailments.
SupportElementalArmamentPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助攻击，被辅助技能击中的敌人每有一种元素异常状态，造成的伤害就会提高，但其本身无法造成元素异常状态。

SupportElementalArmamentPlayerTwo.en: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more Elemental damage.
SupportElementalArmamentPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助攻击，使攻击造成更高元素伤害。

SupportElementalArmyPlayer.en: Supports skills which create Minions, bolstering the Elemental Resistances of those Minions. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.
SupportElementalArmyPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生召唤生物的技能，提高召唤生物的抗性。无法辅助产生无敌召唤生物的技能。

SupportElementalDischargePlayer.en: Supports any Spell that Hits enemies, causing it to Consume Elemental Ailments on hit to trigger an Elemental Discharge. Cannot support the skills of Minions or skills which already Consume Elemental Ailments.
SupportElementalDischargePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的法术，使其在击中时消耗元素异常状态，触发一次元素解放。无法辅助召唤生物的技能，或已会消耗元素异常状态的技能。

SupportElementalFocusPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more Elemental Damage but be unable to inflict Elemental Ailments.
SupportElementalFocusPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，造成更高的元素伤害，但无法造成元素异常状态。

SupportEmbitterPlayer.en: Supports Skills which can Damage Enemies with Hits, causing all sources of Damage Gained to instead be treated as Damage Gained as extra Cold for Supported Skills.
SupportEmbitterPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助能够击中敌人并造成伤害的技能，使从所有来源获得的伤害被视作被辅助技能获得的额外冰霜伤害。

SupportEmpoweredCullPlayer.en: Supports skills that can Empower skills other than themselves, causing skills they Empower to Cull enemies.
SupportEmpoweredCullPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助强化其他技能的技能，使其强化的技能可以终结敌人。

SupportEmpoweredSparksPlayer.en: Supports Skills which generate Charges. When generating Power Charge with Supported Skills, Empower some of your Attacks to Trigger Spark Projectiles on use.
SupportEmpoweredSparksPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可生成能量球的技能。当你使用被辅助的技能生成暴击球时，会强化你的部分攻击，使其在使用时触发火花投射物。

SupportEncroachingGroundPlayer.en: Supports Skills that create Ground Surfaces, causing those Surfaces to grow over time, up to a limit.
SupportEncroachingGroundPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生地面效果的技能，使地面效果持续扩张至特定上限。

SupportEnergyCapacitorPlayer.en: Supports Invocation Skills which Trigger other Skills. Supported Skills have significantly higher Maximum Energy.
SupportEnergyCapacitorPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助触发其他技能的祈求技能。被辅助技能的能量上限大幅提高。

SupportEnergyRetentionPlayer.en: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills gain a chance to partially Refund a portion of Energy cost when Triggering or Invoking other Skills.
SupportEnergyRetentionPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助非凡技能。被辅助技能触发或祈唤其他技能时，有几率返还消耗的一部分能量。

SupportEnergyShieldOnShockKillPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Energy Shield when it kills a Shocked enemy.
SupportEnergyShieldOnShockKillPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，击败感电的敌人时使你回复能量护盾。

SupportEnragedWarcryPlayer.en: Supports Warcries, causing them to spend Rage to bypass their usual Cooldown.
SupportEnragedWarcryPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助战吼，使其可以消耗怒火来跳过常规的冷却时间。

SupportEnragedWarcryPlayerTwo.en: Supports Warcries, causing them to spend Rage to bypass their usual Cooldown.
SupportEnragedWarcryPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助战吼，使其可以消耗怒火来跳过常规的冷却时间。

SupportEonyrsThunderPlayer.en: Supports any Skill which can deal damage. Lightning damage from Supported Skills can inflict Electrocute, but Supported Skills cannot inflict Shock. Enemies slain while Electrocuted by Supported Skills explode, dealing a percentage of their maximum Life as Lightning damage.
SupportEonyrsThunderPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意造成伤害的技能。被辅助技能的闪电伤害可以造成触电，但被辅助技能无法施加感电。被辅助技能的触电击杀的敌人会爆炸，造成其最大生命一定百分比的闪电伤害。

SupportEscalatingPoisonPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing it to inflict an extra Poison on enemies but shortening the duration of those Poisons.
SupportEscalatingPoisonPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其对敌人造成额外的中毒效果，但缩短中毒的持续时间。

SupportEshsRadiancePlayer.en: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Shock.
SupportEshsRadiancePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可造成伤害性击中的技能，提供额外混沌伤害，使混沌伤害作用于感电。

SupportEssenceHarvestPlayer.en: Supports Skills which create Reviving Persistent Minions. When those Minions die, you Recoup a percentage of your maximum Mana.
SupportEssenceHarvestPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助能够产生可复活的永久性召唤生物的技能。这些召唤生物被击败时，为你吸纳一定比例的最大魔力。

SupportEternalMarkPlayer.en: Supports Mark Skills, causing them to not be Consumed the first time they are Activated.
SupportEternalMarkPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助印记技能，使其第一次激活时不会被消耗。

SupportExcisePlayer.en: Supports any damaging Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher chance to Critically Hit, but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.
SupportExcisePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的任意伤害性技能，使其暴击率明显提高，但冷却时间变长。无法辅助本身具有冷却时间的技能。

SupportExecratePlayer.en: Supports any damaging Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher chance to inflict Ailments on hit, but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.
SupportExecratePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的任意伤害性技能，使其击中时造成异常状态的几率明显提高，但冷却时间变长。无法辅助本身具有冷却时间的技能。

SupportExecutePlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life.
SupportExecutePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其对低血敌人造成更高伤害。

SupportExecutePlayerThree.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life, as well as dealing more damage while you are on Low Life.
SupportExecutePlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其对低血敌人造成更高伤害，当你低血时造成的伤害也更高。

SupportExecutePlayerTwo.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life.
SupportExecutePlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其对低血敌人造成更高伤害。

SupportExpandPlayer.en: Supports Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them over time. The Seals are broken when cast, increasing area of effect. Cannot support Channelling Skills or Skills with a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.
SupportExpandPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你施放的法术，使其随时间获得封印。施放时打破封印，扩大效果范围。无法辅助持续引导技能、有冷却时间的技能或能获得封印的技能。

SupportExpansePlayer.en: Supports any Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher Area of Effect but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.
SupportExpansePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的任意技能，使其效果范围明显提高，但冷却时间变长。无法辅助本身具有冷却时间的技能。

SupportExploitWeaknessPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more Damage against enemies with Broken Armour but preventing them from Breaking Armour themselves. Cannot support skills that Consume Broken Armour.
SupportExploitWeaknessPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其对护甲破损的敌人造成更高伤害，但攻击本身无法粉碎护甲。无法辅助消耗护甲破损的技能。

SupportExplosiveGrowthPlayer.en: Supports Plant Skills, causing them to Trigger an explosion after they have been Overgrown.
SupportExplosiveGrowthPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助植物技能与蔓生，使其在蔓生后触发爆炸。

SupportExplosiveGrowthPlayerTwo.en: Supports Plant Skills, causing them to Trigger an explosion after they have been Overgrown, Blinding enemies Hit.
SupportExplosiveGrowthPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助植物技能与蔓生，使其在蔓生后触发爆炸，并致盲被击中的敌人。

SupportExposingCryPlayer.en: Supports Warcries. Supported Skills apply Exposure on Hitting enemies.
SupportExposingCryPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助战吼技能。被辅助的技能在击中敌人时会施加曝露效果。

SupportExtractionPlayer.en: Supports Spell Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Using supported Spells will cause you to Sacrifice a portion of your Life on use, gaining extra Chaos Damage in exchange. Does not support Persistent Skills, Minion Skills, or Triggered Skills.
SupportExtractionPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助造成伤害性击中的法术技能。使用被辅助的法术会使你牺牲一部分生命，并获得额外的混沌伤害。无法辅助永久性技能、召唤生物技能或触发技能。

SupportFanTheFlamesPlayer.en: Supports Wind Skills which Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills against Ignited enemies Trigger a fiery explosion, dealing damage to that enemy and enemies in a cone behind them.
SupportFanTheFlamesPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可击中敌人的风系技能。被辅助的技能击中处于点燃状态的敌人将触发火焰爆炸，对该敌人及其身后的锥形区域内的敌人造成伤害。

SupportFanTheFlamesPlayerTwo.en: Supports Wind Skills which Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills against Ignited enemies Trigger a fiery explosion, dealing damage to that enemy and enemies in a cone behind them. The explosion Spreads the initial enemy's Ignite to other enemies Hit.
SupportFanTheFlamesPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助可击中敌人的风系技能。被辅助的技能击中处于点燃状态的敌人将触发火焰爆炸，对该敌人及其身后的锥形区域内的敌人造成伤害。该爆炸会将初始敌人的点燃状态传播给其他被击中的敌人。

SupportFarCombatPlayer.en: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage from farther away.
SupportFarCombatPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助攻击，使攻击造成更高伤害，距离越远伤害越高。

SupportFarCombatPlayerTwo.en: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage from farther away.
SupportFarCombatPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助攻击，使攻击造成更高伤害，距离越远伤害越高。

SupportFeedingFrenzyPlayer.en: Supports skills which create Minions, making them deal and take more damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.
SupportFeedingFrenzyPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生召唤生物的技能，使召唤生物可以造成和承受更高的伤害。无法辅助产生无敌召唤生物的技能。

SupportFerocityPlayer.en: Supports Skills that you use yourself. Supported Skills will consume a Frenzy Charge on use if possible, and will gain significant Skill Speed if they do, but cannot generate Frenzy Charges. Cannot Support Skills which consume Frenzy Charges.
SupportFerocityPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用的技能。使用被辅助技能时会尽可能消耗一个狂怒球，消耗时大幅提高技能速度。被辅助技能无法产生狂怒球。无法辅助会消耗狂怒球的技能。

SupportFieryDeathPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing enemies it Ignites to have a chance to explode on death.
SupportFieryDeathPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其点燃的敌人被击败时有几率爆炸。

SupportFireExposurePlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Exposure when Igniting.
SupportFireExposurePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其在点燃时施加曝露。

SupportFireMasteryPlayer.en: Supports Fire skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
SupportFireMasteryPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助火焰技能，使其等级提升一级。不能辅助没有等级的技能。

SupportFirePenetrationPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Fire resistance.
SupportFirePenetrationPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使击中能穿透敌人的火焰抗性。

SupportFirePenetrationPlayerTwo.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits ignore enemy Fire resistance.
SupportFirePenetrationPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使击中能忽略敌人的火焰抗性。

SupportFlamePillarPlayer.en: Supports any Skill you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills Consume Ignite on Hit to create pillars of flame, but cannot themselves inflict Ignite. Cannot Support Skills which already Consume Ignite, and does not modify the Skills of Minions.
SupportFlamePillarPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用的可造成伤害性击中的任意技能。被辅助技能击中时消耗点燃产生烈焰之柱，但其本身无法造成点燃。无法辅助已经消耗点燃的技能，不会修改召唤生物的技能。

SupportFlamepiercePlayer.en: Supports Skills which can fire Projectiles. Initial Projectile created by Supported Skills will always Pierce Ignited Enemies, but Supported Skills cannot inflict Ignite themselves.
SupportFlamepiercePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可以发射投射物的技能。被辅助技能的初始投射物必定穿透被点燃的敌人，但被辅助技能自身无法施加点燃。

SupportFleetingRemnantsPlayer.en: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away.
SupportFleetingRemnantsPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生残片的技能，使残片能够从更远处收集。

SupportFleetingRemnantsPlayerTwo.en: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away, with a chance to create an additional Remnant.
SupportFleetingRemnantsPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助产生残片的技能，使残片能够从更远处收集，并有几率创造额外的残片。

SupportFlukePlayer.en: Supports Skills which Trigger other Skills. Skills Triggered by Supported Skills have their Damage randomly raised or lowered when Triggered, as well as recovering a random amount of their cost when Triggered.
SupportFlukePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助触发其他技能的技能。被辅助技能所触发的技能的伤害在被触发时随机增减，触发时还会随机恢复一定比例的消耗。

SupportFlukePlayerTwo.en: Supports Skills which Trigger other Skills. Skills Triggered by Supported Skills have their Damage, Area of Effect, and Projectile Speed randomly raised or lowered when Triggered, as well as recovering a random amount of their cost when Triggered.
SupportFlukePlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助触发其他技能的技能。被辅助技能触发的技能在被触发时伤害、效果范围和投射物速度随机增减，被触发时还会随机回复一定消耗。

SupportFocusedCursePlayer.en: Supports Curse skills, causing them to Curse enemies more quickly after being cast.
SupportFocusedCursePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助诅咒技能，使其在施放后更快地诅咒敌人。

SupportForkPlayer.en: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Fork.
SupportForkPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助投射物技能，使投射物分叉。

SupportFreezePlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more effective at Freezing enemies.
SupportFreezePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其更有效地冻结敌人。

SupportFreezeforkPlayer.en: Supports Skills which can fire Projectiles. Projectiles from Supported Skills always Fork when the initial Projectile Hits Frozen Enemies, but Supported Skills cannot build up Freeze themselves.
SupportFreezeforkPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可以发射投射物的技能。被辅助技能的初始投射物击中被冻结的敌人时，投射物必定分叉，但被辅助技能自身无法累积冻结。

SupportFrenziedRipostePlayer.en: Supports Attacks you use or Trigger yourself, causing them to Consume the Parried Debuff on Hit to grant you a Frenzy Charge. Cannot support Skills which already Consume the Parried Debuff.
SupportFrenziedRipostePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你使用或你自己触发的攻击，使其在击中时消耗被招架的减益状态，使你获得一个狂怒球。无法辅助本就可以消耗被招架的减益状态的技能。

SupportFreshClipPlayer.en: Supports Crossbow Skills, granting them more damage for each bolt reloaded by that Skill in the last 6 seconds.
SupportFreshClipPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助战弩技能，该技能过去 6 秒内每装填一发弩箭都会提高它造成的伤害。

SupportFreshClipPlayerTwo.en: Supports Crossbow Skills, granting them more damage for each bolt reloaded by that Skill in the last 8 seconds.
SupportFreshClipPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助战弩技能，该技能过去 8 秒内每装填一发弩箭都会提高它造成的伤害。

SupportFrostfirePlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to Consume Freeze on Igniting a Frozen enemy to boost the effect of the Ignite. Cannot support skills that Consume Freeze or Ignite.
SupportFrostfirePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其点燃冻结的敌人时消耗冻结效果，以增强点燃的效果。无法辅助会消耗冻结或点燃的技能。

SupportGambleshotPlayer.en: Supports Skills which fire Projectiles that are not ground targeted. Projectiles from Supported Skills randomly Fork, Chain or Pierce.
SupportGambleshotPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助投射物不以地面为目标的技能。被辅助技能的投射物随机分叉、连锁或穿透。

SupportGarukhansResolvePlayer.en: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which do not already have some Condition for use. Supported Skills have a maximum Critical Hit chance, but will Bifurcate Critical Hit Chance.
SupportGarukhansResolvePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用且不具有使用条件的攻击技能。被辅助技能将拥有最大暴击率，但会分叉暴击率。

SupportGlacierPlayer.en: Supports any Skill which creates Ice Crystals, causing them to be created with higher Life.
SupportGlacierPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生冰晶的技能，使其产生的冰晶具有较高的生命。

SupportGorgePlayer.en: Supports skills that consume Corpses. Consuming Corpses with supported skills grants Flask charges.
SupportGorgePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助消耗灵柩的技能。使用被辅助的技能消耗灵柩会获得药剂充能。

SupportGuatelitzisAblationPlayer.en: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills Sacrifice a portion of your life on use. While Offering spikes from Supported Skills persist, you are periodically granted a Power Charge. When spikes from Supported Skills die, Regenerate a percentage of your maximum Life and Mana per second based on the duration the Offering persisted.
SupportGuatelitzisAblationPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助奉献技能。使用被辅助技能会使你牺牲一部分生命。当被辅助技能产生的奉献尖刺存留期间，你会周期性获得一个暴击球。当尖刺消失时，基于该奉献技能的持续时长，每秒回复一定比例的最大生命与魔力。

SupportHaemocrystalsPlayer.en: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills Consume Bleeding on Hit to create explosive blood-filled crystals, but cannot themselves inflict Bleeding. Cannot Support Skills which already Consume Bleeding.
SupportHaemocrystalsPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用的可造成伤害性击中的攻击技能。被辅助技能击中时消耗流血产生爆炸性血晶，但其本身无法造成流血。无法辅助已经消耗流血的技能。

SupportHardyTotemsPlayer.en: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life.
SupportHardyTotemsPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生图腾的技能，使其产生的图腾拥有更多生命。

SupportHardyTotemsPlayerThree.en: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life. Totems created by Supported Skills explode on death, dealing Physical damage based on their Life.
SupportHardyTotemsPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助产生图腾的技能，使图腾拥有更多生命。被辅助技能产生的图腾被击败时爆炸，根据其生命造成物理伤害。

SupportHardyTotemsPlayerTwo.en: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life.
SupportHardyTotemsPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助产生图腾的技能，使其产生的图腾拥有更多生命。

SupportHayoxisBindingPlayer.en: Supports Curse Skills, giving them a short cooldown but causing them to create areas which Curse enemies so long as they are within them. Cursed areas from Supported Skills gather power before erupting in a column of annihilating light after a moderate delay.
SupportHayoxisBindingPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助诅咒类技能。被辅助技能会拥有短暂的冷却时间，但会生成多个区域，敌人处于区域内将持续被诅咒。被辅助技能生成的诅咒区域会积蓄力量，经过短暂延迟后迸发一束摧残之光。

SupportHeavyStunEndurancePlayerOne.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to gain an Endurance Charge when causing a Heavy Stun.
SupportHeavyStunEndurancePlayerOne.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其造成重度晕眩时有几率获得一个耐力球。

SupportHeavyStunEndurancePlayerTwo.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to gain an Endurance Charge when causing a Heavy Stun.
SupportHeavyStunEndurancePlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其造成重度晕眩时有几率获得一个耐力球。

SupportHeftPlayer.en: Supports Skills which deal Damage, increasing the maximum Physical Damage of their Hits.
SupportHeftPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助造成伤害的技能，使其造成的击中物理伤害上限提高。

SupportHeightenedAccuracyPlayer.en: Supports Attacks, causing them to gain Accuracy.
SupportHeightenedAccuracyPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助攻击，使攻击的命中提高。

SupportHeightenedAccuracyPlayerTwo.en: Supports Attacks, causing them to gain Accuracy, and never miss against Enemies on full Life.
SupportHeightenedAccuracyPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助攻击，使攻击的命中提高，且对满血敌人永不落空。

SupportHeightenedChargesPlayer.en: Supports any Skill that Consumes Charges, granting a chance for benefits of that Consumption to be doubled.
SupportHeightenedChargesPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助消耗能量球的技能，使消耗的加成有几率翻倍。

SupportHelbrymsHidePlayer.en: Supports Shapeshifting Skills, causing them to grant Helbrym's Composure for a brief duration when they cause you to Shapeshift. Shapeshifting into a different form before the Buff expires causes it to be removed without effect.
SupportHelbrymsHidePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助变形技能，使你变形时，于短时间内获得赫尔布林的沉着。若在结束前再次变形为不同形态，该增益状态将被移除且不产生效果。

SupportHerbalismPlayer.en: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Life recovery from Flasks while the Skill is active.
SupportHerbalismPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助永久性增益技能，激活该技能时提高你从药剂获得的生命回复。

SupportHerbalismPlayerTwo.en: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Life recovery from Flasks while the Skill is active.
SupportHerbalismPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助永久性增益技能，激活该技能时提高你从药剂获得的生命回复。

SupportHexBloomPlayer.en: Supports Curses, spreading their effects when a Cursed enemy dies.
SupportHexBloomPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助诅咒，当一个被诅咒的敌人被击败时，效果会被散播。

SupportHitAndRunPlayer.en: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which do not already have some Condition for use. Supported Skills can only be used after you have moved a certain distance, but have massively increased Skill Speed. Cannot support Skills which have a cooldown.
SupportHitAndRunPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用且不具有使用条件的攻击技能。被辅助技能只能在你移动了一定距离后使用，但会大幅提高技能速度。无法辅助具有冷却时间的技能。

SupportHolyDescentPlayer.en: Supports Skills that leap into the air, causing them to create Consecrated Ground when you land.
SupportHolyDescentPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助跃入空中的技能，使其在你落地时产生奉献地面。

SupportHourglassPlayer.en: Supports any damaging skill that you use yourself, causing it to deal significantly more damage but gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.
SupportHourglassPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的任意伤害性技能，使其造成的伤害明显提升，但冷却时间变长。无法辅助本身具有冷却时间的技能。

SupportHulkingMinionsPlayer.en: Supports Skills which summon Persistent Minions. Supported Minions are larger, have more Life, and deal more Damage, but cost significantly more Spirit.
SupportHulkingMinionsPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助能够召唤永久性召唤生物的技能。被辅助的召唤生物体型变大，具有更多生命，造成更高的伤害，但大幅提高精魂消耗。

SupportIceBitePlayer.en: Supports damaging skills and Warcries you use yourself. Freezing an enemy with supported skills infuses your damage with Cold damage for a short time.
SupportIceBitePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助造成伤害的技能和战吼。使用被辅助技能冻结敌人后，你在短时间内附加冰霜伤害。

SupportIceBitePlayerTwo.en: Supports damaging skills and Warcries you use yourself. Freezing an enemy with supported skills infuses your damage with Cold damage for a short time.
SupportIceBitePlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助造成伤害的技能和战吼。使用被辅助技能冻结敌人后，你在短时间内附加冰霜伤害。

SupportIciclePlayer.en: Supports any Skill which creates Ice Crystals, causing them to be created with lower Life.
SupportIciclePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生冰晶的技能，使其产生的冰晶具有较低的生命。

SupportIgniteDurationPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing its Ignites to be inflicted less often but last longer.
SupportIgniteDurationPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其造成点燃的频率降低，但效果的持续时间延长。

SupportIgniteDurationPlayerThree.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to refresh Ignites on Critical Hit.
SupportIgniteDurationPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其暴击时刷新点燃持续时间。

SupportIgniteDurationPlayerTwo.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing its Ignites to last longer.
SupportIgniteDurationPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其造成的点燃持续时间延长。

SupportIgnitePlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Ignite.
SupportIgnitePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其有更高几率造成点燃。

SupportIgnitePlayerThree.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Ignite and causing inflicted Ignites to deal their damage more quickly.
SupportIgnitePlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其有更高几率造成点燃，并提高施加的点燃造成伤害的速度。

SupportIgnitePlayerTwo.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Ignite.
SupportIgnitePlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其有更高几率造成点燃。

SupportImmolatePlayer.en: Supports Attacks, granting them extra Fire damage against Ignited enemies but making them unable to Ignite enemies themselves.
SupportImmolatePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助攻击，使其对点燃的敌人造成额外的火焰伤害，但攻击本身无法点燃敌人。

SupportImpalePlayer.en: Supports Attacks, causing them to Impale on Hit but making them unable to Extract Impale themselves.
SupportImpalePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助攻击，使其在击中时造成穿刺，但其本身无法提取穿刺。

SupportIncisionPlayer.en: Supports Attack Skills. Supported Skills inflict Incision on Hit, which causes Enemies to be increasingly more likely to be inflicted with Bleeding. All Incision is removed from a target on inflicting it with Bleeding.
SupportIncisionPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助攻击技能。被辅助技能在击中时施加创口，使敌人受到流血的几率大幅提高。对目标造成流血会移除其受到的所有创口。

SupportIncreaseLimitPlayer.en: Supports Skills which have a Limit, increasing that Limit at the cost of their duration. Only applies to restrictions that use the word "Limit".
SupportIncreaseLimitPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助有上限的数量效果的技能，以缩短持续时间为代价提高数量上限。仅对明确标注“上限”词缀的技能生效。

SupportIncreaseLimitPlayerTwo.en: Supports Skills which have a Limit, increasing that Limit at the cost of their duration. Only applies to restrictions that use the word "Limit".
SupportIncreaseLimitPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助有上限的数量效果的技能，以缩短持续时间为代价提高数量上限。仅对明确标注“上限”词缀的技能生效。

SupportIncreasedCriticalDamagePlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage with Critical Hits but have less Critical Hit chance.
SupportIncreasedCriticalDamagePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使暴击造成更高伤害，但降低暴击几率。

SupportInevitableCriticalsPlayer.en: Supports any skill you use yourself that Hits enemies, causing it to accumulate Critical Hit chance over time.
SupportInevitableCriticalsPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意你使用的击中敌人的技能，使其持续累积暴击几率。

SupportInevitableCriticalsPlayerTwo.en: Supports any skill you use yourself that Hits enemies, causing it to accumulate Critical Hit chance over time, but also reduce your Critical Damage Bonus.
SupportInevitableCriticalsPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助任意你使用的击中敌人的技能，使其持续累积暴击几率，但会降低你的暴击伤害加成。

SupportInfernalLegionPlayer.en: Supports skills which create Minions which can be damaged, causing them and enemies near them to Ignite. The damage of the Ignite is based on the Life of the supported Minion.
SupportInfernalLegionPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生可受到伤害的召唤生物的技能，点燃召唤生物和周围的敌人。点燃伤害基于被辅助召唤生物的生命值。

SupportInfernalLegionPlayerThree.en: Supports skills which create Minions which can be damaged, causing them and enemies near them to Ignite. The damage of the Ignite is based on the Life of the supported Minion.
SupportInfernalLegionPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助产生可受到伤害的召唤生物的技能，点燃召唤生物和周围的敌人。点燃伤害基于被辅助召唤生物的生命值。

SupportInfernalLegionPlayerTwo.en: Supports skills which create Minions which can be damaged, causing them and enemies near them to Ignite. The damage of the Ignite is based on the Life of the supported Minion.
SupportInfernalLegionPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助产生可受到伤害的召唤生物的技能，点燃召唤生物和周围的敌人。点燃伤害基于被辅助召唤生物的生命值。

SupportInnervatePlayer.en: Supports damaging skills you use yourself. Killing a Shocked enemy with supported skills imbues your damage with Lightning damage for a short time.
SupportInnervatePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用的造成伤害的技能，使用被辅助技能击败一个感电的敌人后，你在短时间内附加闪电伤害。

SupportIntenseAgonyPlayer.en: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment damage over time, causing them to have a shorter duration but deal substantially more damage over time with Debuffs inflicted against enemies on full life.
SupportIntenseAgonyPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助造成非异常状态的持续伤害的法术，缩短持续时间，但大幅提高对满血敌人施加的减益状态所造成的持续伤害。

SupportInterludePlayer.en: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful.
SupportInterludePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生残片的技能，使残片更加强大。

SupportInterludePlayerThree.en: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful, but delaying their effect.
SupportInterludePlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助产生残片的技能，使残片更加强大，但延迟其效果。

SupportInterludePlayerTwo.en: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful, but delaying their effect.
SupportInterludePlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助产生残片的技能，使残片更加强大，但延迟其效果。

SupportJaggedGroundPlayer.en: Supports Slam skills. Supported Skills will consume Endurance Charges on use to create Jagged Ground. Cannot Support Skills which consume Endurance Charges.
SupportJaggedGroundPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助猛击技能。被辅助技能使用时会消耗耐力球来创造崎岖之地。无法辅助会消耗耐力球的技能。

SupportJaggedGroundPlayerTwo.en: Supports Slam skills. Aftershocks caused by Supported Slam Skills always create patches of Jagged Ground.
SupportJaggedGroundPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助猛击技能。被辅助猛击技能造成的余震总是创造崎岖之地。

SupportKalisasCrescendoPlayer.en: Supports Curse Skills. Enemies Cursed by Supported Skills are Pacified for the final portion of the Supported Curse's duration.
SupportKalisasCrescendoPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助诅咒技能。被辅助技能诅咒的敌人在被辅助诅咒持续时间的最后阶段被宁心。

SupportKaomsMadnessPlayer.en: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create many additional fissures at the cost of damage, speed, and area of effect.
SupportKaomsMadnessPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助在地上产生裂缝的技能，使其产生大量额外的裂缝，但会牺牲伤害、攻击速度和效果范围。

SupportKhatalsRejuvenationPlayer.en: Supports Skills that generate Remnants. Picking up Remnants from Supported Skills grants Khatal's Rejuvenation.
SupportKhatalsRejuvenationPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可生成残片的技能。拾取被辅助技能生成的残片时，将获得卡塔尔的复苏。

SupportKnockbackPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to Knock Back enemies.
SupportKnockbackPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其可以击退敌人。

SupportKnockbackWavePlayer.en: Supports any skill that you can use, triggering a blast of wind that Knocks Back enemies if you are Stunned while using it.
SupportKnockbackWavePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的任意技能，使你在晕眩状态下使用时，触发一阵可击退敌人的疾风。

SupportKulemaksDominionPlayer.en: Supports Offering Skills, causing your Cascadable Spells to Cascade to the locations of Supported Offerings.
SupportKulemaksDominionPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助奉献技能，使你的可扩散法术扩散至被辅助的奉献技能的所在位置。

SupportKurgalsLeashPlayer.en: Supports Commandable Minions causing you and the Supported Minion to gain Unholy Might when you Command them.
SupportKurgalsLeashPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可命令的召唤生物，使你和被辅助召唤生物在命令它们时获得不洁之力。

SupportLastGaspPlayer.en: Supports Skills that create Persistent Minions, causing those Minions to fight on when they are fatally wounded, dying after a short duration.
SupportLastGaspPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助能够产生永久性召唤生物的技能，使召唤生物在受到致命伤害后仍会继续战斗，并在短时间内死亡。

SupportLastingFrostPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing Freeze it inflicts to last longer.
SupportLastingFrostPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助击中敌人的技能，延长其造成的冻结效果。

SupportLastingGroundPlayer.en: Supports Skills that create Ground Surfaces, causing those surfaces to last longer.
SupportLastingGroundPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生地面效果的技能，使地面效果的持续时间延长。

SupportLastingShockPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies or inflicts Shock, causing its Shocks to be inflicted less often but last longer.
SupportLastingShockPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人或造成感电的技能，使其造成感电的频率降低，但效果的持续时间延长。

SupportLifeFlaskPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing enemies it kills to grant more Life Flask charges.
SupportLifeFlaskPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其击败敌人后获得更多的生命药剂充能。

SupportLifeLeechPlayer.en: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life.
SupportLifeLeechPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助攻击，使攻击的物理伤害可以偷取生命。

SupportLifeLeechPlayerThree.en: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life and preventing Leech gained this way from being removed at full Life.
SupportLifeLeechPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助攻击，使其物理伤害可以偷取生命，且在满血时不会移除偷取效果。

SupportLifeLeechPlayerTwo.en: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life.
SupportLifeLeechPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助攻击，使攻击的物理伤害可以偷取生命。

SupportLifeOnCullPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Life when it Culls an enemy.
SupportLifeOnCullPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使你在终结一个敌人时回复生命。

SupportLightningExposurePlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Exposure when inflicting Shock.
SupportLightningExposurePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其在施加感电时施加曝露。

SupportLightningMasteryPlayer.en: Supports Lightning skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
SupportLightningMasteryPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助闪电技能，使其等级提升一级。不能辅助没有等级的技能。

SupportLightningPenetrationPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Lightning resistance.
SupportLightningPenetrationPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使击中能穿透敌人的闪电抗性。

SupportLivingLightningPlayer.en: Supports Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Living Lightning Minions are created when dealing Lightning damage with Supported Skills - bundles of living electricity that target nearby enemies with Chaining Attacks. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them. Does not modify skills used by Minions.
SupportLivingLightningPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助造成伤害性击中的技能。被辅助技能造成闪电伤害时产生活体闪电召唤生物 - 以连锁攻击攻击附近敌人的活体电流。敌人不会直接攻击这些召唤生物，但可以穿过它们。不会修改召唤生物使用的技能。

SupportLivingLightningPlayerTwo.en: Supports Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Living Lightning Minions are created when dealing Lightning damage with Supported Skills - bundles of living electricity that target nearby enemies with Chaining Attacks. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them. Does not modify skills used by Minions.
SupportLivingLightningPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助造成伤害性击中的技能。被辅助技能造成闪电伤害时产生活体闪电召唤生物 - 以连锁攻击攻击附近敌人的活体电流。敌人不会直接攻击这些召唤生物，但可以穿过它们。不会修改召唤生物使用的技能。

SupportLockdownPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing any Pin buildup it inflicts to be stronger the closer the enemy is to you.
SupportLockdownPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其对距离越近的敌人造成越高的定身积蓄值。

SupportLongFusePlayer.en: Supports Skills which have a Detonation Time, causing those Skills to have much higher Detonation Time and detonation damage.
SupportLongFusePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助具有引爆时间的技能，使技能的引爆时间和引爆伤害大幅提高。

SupportLongFusePlayerTwo.en: Supports Skills which have a Detonation Time, causing those Skills to have much higher Detonation Time and detonation damage.
SupportLongFusePlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助具有引爆时间的技能，使技能的引爆时间和引爆伤害大幅提高。

SupportLoyaltyPlayer.en: Supports Skills that create Companions which can be damaged. Minions created by Supported Skills take a portion of Hit Damage you would otherwise have taken, but have lowered maximum Life.
SupportLoyaltyPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生能够受到伤害的伙伴的技能。被辅助技能产生的召唤生物会替你承担一定比例的击中伤害，但其生命上限降低。

SupportMagneticRemnantsPlayer.en: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away.
SupportMagneticRemnantsPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生残片的技能，使残片能够从更远处收集。

SupportMagnifiedAreaPlayer.en: Supports any skill with an area of effect, making it larger.
SupportMagnifiedAreaPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意有范围效果的技能，使范围扩大。

SupportMagnifiedAreaPlayerTwo.en: Supports any skill with an area of effect, making it larger.
SupportMagnifiedAreaPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助任意有范围效果的技能，使范围扩大。

SupportMaimPlayer.en: Supports Attacks, causing them to Maim enemies.
SupportMaimPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助攻击，使攻击可以瘫痪敌人。

SupportMaladyPlayer.en: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits, causing base chance to inflict Bleeding with Supported Skills to instead apply to base chance to Poison, and causing base chance to Poison to instead apply to Bleeding.
