SupportMaladyPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助造成伤害性击中的技能，使被辅助技能造成流血的基础几率改为对中毒的基础几率生效，中毒的基础几率生效改为对流血生效。

SupportManaFlarePlayer.en: Supports any Spell that Hits enemies, causing it to trigger a Mana Flare on Critical Hit. The Mana Flare consumes your Mana to deal Fire damage. Cannot support the skills of Minions.
SupportManaFlarePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的法术，使其在暴击时触发一次魔力耀斑。魔力耀斑会消耗你的魔力并造成火焰伤害。无法辅助召唤生物的技能。

SupportManaFlaskPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing enemies it kills to grant more Mana Flask charges.
SupportManaFlaskPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其击败敌人后获得更多的魔力药剂充能。

SupportManaFountainPlayer.en: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by supported Skills generate a Font of Mana which will Leech Mana to Allies within it.
SupportManaFountainPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生图腾的技能。被辅助技能产生的图腾生成魔力源泉，为范围内的友军偷取魔力。

SupportManaLeechPlayer.en: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Mana.
SupportManaLeechPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助攻击，使攻击的物理伤害可以偷取魔力。

SupportManaOnCullPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Mana when it Culls an enemy.
SupportManaOnCullPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使你在终结一个敌人时回复魔力。

SupportMarkForDeathPlayer.en: Supports Mark Skills. Enemies affected by Supported Marks will have their Armour Broken by Physical Damage they take.
SupportMarkForDeathPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助印记技能。受被辅助印记技能影响的敌人，在受到物理伤害时，护甲破损。

SupportMarkForDeathPlayerTwo.en: Supports Mark Skills. Enemies affected by Supported Marks will have their Armour Broken by Physical Damage they take.
SupportMarkForDeathPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助印记技能。受被辅助印记技能影响的敌人，在受到物理伤害时，护甲破损。

SupportMarkOfSiphoningPlayer.en: Supports Mark Skills, causing enemies they Mark to Leech Mana to you when you Hit them with Attacks.
SupportMarkOfSiphoningPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助印记技能，你的攻击击中被施加印记的敌人时可偷取魔力。

SupportMarkOfSiphoningPlayerTwo.en: Supports Mark Skills, causing enemies they Mark to Leech Life and Mana to you when you Hit them with Attacks.
SupportMarkOfSiphoningPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助印记技能，你的攻击击中被施加印记的敌人时可偷取生命和魔力。

SupportMeatShieldPlayer.en: Supports skills which create Minions, granting them less damage taken but making them deal less damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.
SupportMeatShieldPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生召唤生物的技能，使召唤生物受到的伤害降低，但造成的伤害也会降低。无法辅助产生无敌召唤生物的技能。

SupportMeatShieldPlayerTwo.en: Supports skills which create Minions, granting them less damage taken but making them deal less damage.
SupportMeatShieldPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助产生召唤生物的技能，使召唤生物受到的伤害降低，但造成的伤害也会降低。

SupportMeleePhysicalDamagePlayer.en: Supports Melee Attacks, boosting their Physical damage at the cost of Attack Speed.
SupportMeleePhysicalDamagePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助近战攻击，以攻击速度为代价，提高物理伤害。

SupportMinionInstabilityPlayer.en: Supports skills which create Minions, causing them to violently explode when reduced to Low Life.
SupportMinionInstabilityPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生召唤生物的技能，使召唤生物在低血时剧烈爆炸。

SupportMinionMasteryPlayer.en: Supports Minion skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
SupportMinionMasteryPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助召唤生物技能，使其等级提升一级。不能辅助没有等级的技能。

SupportMinionMeleeSplashPlayer.en: Supports Skills which create Minions which Strike, causing those Minions' Strikes to have Melee Splash.
SupportMinionMeleeSplashPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可创造召唤生物并进行打击的技能，使这些召唤生物的打击获得近战伤害扩散效果。

SupportMinionMeleeSplashPlayerTwo.en: Supports Skills which create Minions which Strike, increasing their Area of Effect and causing those Minions' Strikes to have Melee Splash.
SupportMinionMeleeSplashPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助可创造召唤生物并进行打击的技能，扩大其效果范围，并使这些召唤生物的打击获得近战伤害扩散效果。

SupportMinionPactPlayer.en: Supports damaging skills you use yourself, draining the life from one of your Minions on use in order to boost the skill's damage. Only takes effect if you have a Minion with enough life to drain the full amount.
SupportMinionPactPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的伤害性技能，使用时吸取你的一个召唤生物的生命，以提升技能的伤害。仅在你的召唤生物拥有足量的生命能够吸取时生效。

SupportMinionPactPlayerTwo.en: Supports damaging skills you use yourself, draining the life from one of your Minions on use in order to boost the skill's damage. Only takes effect if you have a Minion with enough life to drain the full amount.
SupportMinionPactPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的伤害性技能，使用时吸取你的一个召唤生物的生命，以提升技能的伤害。仅在你的召唤生物拥有足量的生命能够吸取时生效。

SupportMobilityPlayer.en: Supports skills that can be used while moving, allowing you to move faster while using them.
SupportMobilityPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可在移动时使用的技能，使你在使用时可以更快地移动。

SupportMomentumPlayer.en: Supports any damaging skill that you use yourself, causing it to deal more damage if you move a sufficient distance while using the skill. Teleportation does not count towards the distance travelled.
SupportMomentumPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意你使用的伤害性技能，如果使用技能期间移动了足够的距离，使其造成更高的伤害。传送不会计入移动距离。

SupportMorganasTempestPlayer.en: Supports Storm skills, increasing their Limit and causing them to move quickly from the user to the target location, but become less effective. Cannot Support Triggered Skills.
SupportMorganasTempestPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助风暴技能，增加其数量上限，并使其从玩家处更快移向目标地点，但效果会减弱。无法辅助触发类技能。

SupportMultishotPlayer.en: Supports Projectile skills, making them fire extra Projectiles. Also lowers Attack and Cast speed of supported skills, as well as lessening their damage.
SupportMultishotPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助投射物技能，可以发射额外的投射物。同时降低被辅助技能的攻击和施法速度，并降低它们的伤害。

SupportMultishotPlayerTwo.en: Supports Projectile skills, making them fire extra Projectiles. Also lowers Attack and Cast speed of supported skills, as well as lessening their damage.
SupportMultishotPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助投射物技能，可以发射额外的投射物。同时降低被辅助技能的攻击和施法速度，并降低它们的伤害。

SupportMusterPlayer.en: Supports Skills which summon Minions. Supported Minions deal more Damage the more different kinds of Reviving Minions you have summoned.
SupportMusterPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助能够召唤出召唤生物的技能。你召唤的可复活的召唤生物类型越多，被辅助的召唤生物造成的伤害越高。

SupportMysticismPlayer.en: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Spell Damage while on full Energy Shield while the Supported Skill is active.
SupportMysticismPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助永久性增益状态技能，激活被辅助技能且能量护盾已满时，提高你造成的法术伤害。

SupportMysticismPlayerTwo.en: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Spell Damage while on full Energy Shield while the Supported Skill is active.
SupportMysticismPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助永久性增益状态技能，激活被辅助技能且能量护盾已满时，提高你造成的法术伤害。

SupportNeuralOverloadPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies. Nearby enemies are marked when they are Primed for Electrocution, and hitting a marked enemy with a supported skill will Electrocute them.
SupportNeuralOverloadPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，当附近的敌人可被触电时会被添加一个印记，使用被辅助的技能击中携带印记的敌人会对其造成触电。

SupportNimbleReloadPlayer.en: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to Reload bolts significantly faster.
SupportNimbleReloadPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助战弩弹药技能，使其装填弩箭的速度大幅加快。

SupportNovaProjectilesPlayer.en: Supports Projectile Skills, making them fire Projectiles in a circle. Does not Support Skills which rain down Projectiles from above.
SupportNovaProjectilesPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助投射物技能，使其环形发射火焰投射物，但伤害降低并附加冷却时间。无法辅助自上方落下投射物的技能。

SupportNovaProjectilesTwoPlayer.en: Supports Projectile Skills, making them fire extra Projectiles in a circle, at the cost of Damage and gaining a cooldown. Does not Support Skills which rain down Projectiles from above. Cannot Support Skills which already have a cooldown.
SupportNovaProjectilesTwoPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助投射物类技能，使其以环形发射额外投射物，但会降低伤害并获得冷却时间。无法辅助从空中降下投射物的技能，也无法辅助已有冷却时间的技能。

SupportOisinsOathPlayer.en: Supports Skills which Hit enemies, causing their Mana Leech to recover based on Elemental damage instead of Physical damage.
SupportOisinsOathPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其魔力偷取效果改为基于元素伤害而非物理伤害进行恢复。

SupportOpeningMovePlayer.en: Supports Travel Skills which Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills against enemies on full life will Daze.
SupportOpeningMovePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可击中敌人的旅行技能。被辅助的技能对满血敌人的击中将造成恍惚。

SupportOverchargePlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making its Shocks more effective but reflecting them back to you as well.
SupportOverchargePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其产生的感电效果增强，但也会反射到你身上。

SupportOverextendPlayer.en: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills deal more Damage with Critical Hits, but Critically Hitting an Enemy with them will Daze you for a short time.
SupportOverextendPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用的攻击技能。被辅助技能的暴击造成更高的伤害，但对敌人造成暴击会使你短暂地陷入恍惚。

SupportOverreachPlayer.en: Supports Attack Skills which deal Damage in an Area. Supported Skills have significantly increased Area of Effect, but are less Accurate against nearby targets.
SupportOverreachPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助在范围内造成伤害的攻击技能。被辅助技能的效果范围大幅提高，但对周围目标的命中降低。

SupportPayloadPlayer.en: Supports Skills which fire Grenades, giving fired Grenades a chance to activate again, but lengthening their cooldowns.
SupportPayloadPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助发射榴弹的技能，使发射的榴弹有几率再次激活，但延长冷却时间。

SupportPerfectEndurancePlayer.en: Supports skills which have a benefit for Perfect Timing. Supported Skills grant at least one Endurance Charge when Hitting an enemy with Perfect Timing.
SupportPerfectEndurancePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助在完美时机使用能获得加成的技能。被辅助技能以完美时机击中敌人时，至少获得一个耐力球。

SupportPerfectionPlayer.en: Supports skills which have a benefit for Perfectly Timing their use. On successfully executing Perfect Timing with Supported Skills, gain Perfection, which is a powerful damage buff. However, failing to execute any Perfect Timing (even with skills not supported by Perfection) will remove all Perfection on you.
SupportPerfectionPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助在完美时机使用能获得加成的技能。被辅助技能成功把握完美时机会获得完美增益状态，大幅提高伤害。未能把握完美时机（包括未受到完美辅助的技能）会移除你身上的所有完美状态。

SupportPerpetualChargePlayer.en: Supports skills that consume Power, Frenzy or Endurance Charges on use, giving them a chance not to remove each Charge while still gaining the benefits of consuming them.
SupportPerpetualChargePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助使用时消耗暴击球、狂怒球或耐力球的技能，使其有几率不消耗每一种能量球，并依然获得消耗的效果。

SupportPersistentGroundPlayer.en: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer.
SupportPersistentGroundPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助能够产生地面效果的技能，使产生的地面效果持续时间大幅延长。

SupportPersistentGroundPlayerThree.en: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer as well as lowering the Cooldown Recovery Speed of affected Enemies. Ground Surfaces from Supported Skills only end when their duration expires.
SupportPersistentGroundPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助能够产生地面效果的技能，使创造的地面效果持续时间大幅延长，并降低受影响敌人的冷却回复速度。被辅助技能的地面效果只在持续时间结束时消失。

SupportPersistentGroundPlayerTwo.en: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer and only end when their duration expires.
SupportPersistentGroundPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助能够产生地面效果的技能，使产生的地面效果持续时间大幅延长，且仅会在持续时间结束时消失。

SupportPhysicalMasteryPlayer.en: Supports Physical skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
SupportPhysicalMasteryPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助物理技能，使其等级提升一级。不能辅助没有等级的技能。

SupportPiercePlayer.en: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an enemy but deal less damage after doing so.
SupportPiercePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助投射物技能，使其投射物可以穿透一个敌人，但穿透后造成的伤害降低。

SupportPiercePlayerThree.en: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an unlimited number of enemies, losing damage as they do so.
SupportPiercePlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助投射物技能，使其投射物可以穿透无限数量的敌人，但穿透时会损失伤害。

SupportPiercePlayerTwo.en: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an enemy.
SupportPiercePlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助投射物技能，使其投射物可以穿透一个敌人。

SupportPietysMercyPlayer.en: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain more times.
SupportPietysMercyPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助投射物技能及其他可连锁的技能，增加它们的连锁次数。

SupportPinPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing its Physical damage to Pin enemies but making it unable to Stun.
SupportPinPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其物理伤害可以对敌人造成定身，但无法造成晕眩。

SupportPinPlayerThree.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing its Physical damage to Pin enemies but making it unable to Stun. Pin buildup caused by Supported Skill is lessened, but Pin duration is significantly longer.
SupportPinPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其物理伤害可以对敌人造成定身，但无法造成晕眩。被辅助技能造成的定身积蓄降低，但定身持续时间大幅延长。

SupportPinPlayerTwo.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing its Physical damage to Pin enemies but making it unable to Stun, as well as granting Critial Hit Chance against Immobilised enemies.
SupportPinPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其物理伤害可以对敌人造成定身，但无法造成晕眩，并获得对不可移动敌人的暴击几率。

SupportPinpointCriticalPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to Critically Hit more often but deal less damage with Critical Hits.
SupportPinpointCriticalPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助击中敌人的技能，使其暴击几率提高，但暴击时造成的伤害降低。

SupportPoisonPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Poison enemies.
SupportPoisonPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其有几率令敌人中毒。

SupportPoisonPlayerThree.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Poison enemies and causing it to inflict more powerful Poisons against Bleeding Enemies.
SupportPoisonPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其有几率令敌人中毒，并对流血敌人造成更强的中毒效果。

SupportPoisonPlayerTwo.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Poison enemies.
SupportPoisonPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其有几率令敌人中毒。

SupportPoisonSpores.en: Supports Plant Skills which Hit enemies. Supported Skills Trigger Toxic Pustule on Hitting an enemy.
SupportPoisonSpores.zh_cn: 辅助可击中敌人的植物技能与蔓生。被辅助的技能在击中敌人时触发剧毒芽孢。

SupportPotentExposurePlayer.en: Supports Skills which apply Exposure to Enemies, increasing the effect of applied Exposure.
SupportPotentExposurePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助对敌人施加曝露的技能，提高施加的曝露的效果。

SupportPracticalMagicPlayer.en: Supports Skills which Hit enemies. Heavy Stunning an enemy with Supported Skills increases your Spell damage for a duration.
SupportPracticalMagicPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可击中敌人的技能。使用被辅助的技能使敌人重度晕眩后，会在持续一段时间内提高你的法术伤害。

SupportPracticalMagicPlayerTwo.en: Supports Skills which Hit enemies. Heavy Stunning an enemy with Supported Skills increases your Spell damage for a duration.
SupportPracticalMagicPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助可击中敌人的技能。使用被辅助的技能使敌人重度晕眩后，会在持续一段时间内提高你的法术伤害。

SupportPracticedComboPlayer.en: Supports Strike Skills. Supported Skills have a chance to build additional Combo on Hit. Cannot support Skills used by Minions.
SupportPracticedComboPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助打击技能。被辅助技能击中时有几率积累额外的连击。无法辅助召唤生物使用的技能。

SupportPrecisionPlayer.en: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Accuracy while the Skill is active.
SupportPrecisionPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助永久性增益技能，激活该技能时提高你的命中。

SupportPrecisionPlayerTwo.en: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Accuracy while the Skill is active.
SupportPrecisionPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助永久性增益技能，激活该技能时提高你的命中。

SupportProfanityPlayer.en: Supports Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills consume a Corpse on use, dealing more Chaos Damage if they do.
SupportProfanityPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用的技能。被辅助技能在使用时消耗一个灵柩，消耗时造成更高的混沌伤害。

SupportProfanityPlayerTwo.en: Supports Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills consume many Corpses on use, dealing more Chaos Damage per Corpse consumed.
SupportProfanityPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用的技能。被辅助技能使用时消耗大量灵柩，每消耗一个灵柩就能造成更高的混沌伤害。

SupportProjectileAccelerationPlayer.en: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster.
SupportProjectileAccelerationPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助投射物技能，使投射物速度加快。

SupportProjectileAccelerationPlayerThree.en: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster, and causing increases and reductions to Projectile speed to also apply to Damage.
SupportProjectileAccelerationPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助投射物技能，使投射物速度加快，投射物速度的加成与减少同样作用于伤害。

SupportProjectileAccelerationPlayerTwo.en: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster, and granting them a chance to Pierce Enemies.
SupportProjectileAccelerationPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助投射物技能，使投射物速度加快，并使其有几率穿透敌人。

SupportProjectileDecelerationPlayer.en: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel more slowly.
SupportProjectileDecelerationPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助投射物技能，使投射物速度减慢。

SupportProjectileDecelerationPlayerTwo.en: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel more slowly.
SupportProjectileDecelerationPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助投射物技能，使投射物速度减慢。

SupportPunchThroughPlayer.en: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills apply Easy Target when Knocking Back Enemies, causing the next Projectile Attack Hit they take to deal increased Damage.
SupportPunchThroughPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助近战攻击技能。被辅助技能击退敌人时施加活靶子，使其受到的下一次投射物攻击击中造成更高的伤害。

SupportPursuitPlayer.en: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.
SupportPursuitPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助近战攻击。如果你在过去八秒内造成过投射物攻击击中，被辅助技能造成的近战伤害会提高，但其本身无法造成投射物伤害。

SupportPursuitPlayerThree.en: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last two seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.
SupportPursuitPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助近战攻击。如果你在过去两秒内造成过投射物攻击击中，被辅助技能造成的近战伤害会提高，但其本身无法造成投射物伤害。

SupportPursuitPlayerTwo.en: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.
SupportPursuitPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助近战攻击。如果你在过去八秒内造成过投射物攻击击中，被辅助技能造成的近战伤害会提高，但其本身无法造成投射物伤害。

SupportQuillburstPlayer.en:
Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills trigger Quill Burst, which deals your Thorns Damage in an Area around the target struck. Quill Burst can only be triggered on Hit after you've
Retaliated with Thorns Damage.
SupportQuillburstPlayer.zh_cn:
辅助近战攻击技能。被辅助技能会触发棘刺爆发，对击中的目标周围的区域造成你的荆棘伤害。只有当你用荆棘进行反击后，
才能在击中时触发棘刺爆发。

SupportRagePlayer.en: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit.
SupportRagePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助近战攻击，使攻击在击中时获得怒火。

SupportRagePlayerThree.en: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit. Supported Skills have signficantly higher Attack speed while you or supported minion are not at maximum Rage.
SupportRagePlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助近战攻击，使攻击在击中时获得怒火。当你或被辅助的召唤生物的怒火不满时，被辅助技能的攻击速度大幅提高。

SupportRagePlayerTwo.en: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit.
SupportRagePlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助近战攻击，使攻击在击中时获得怒火。

SupportRageforgedPlayer.en: Supports any damaging skill that you use or Trigger yourself, causing it to spend Rage to deal more damage. If you don't have enough Rage to spend, the damage bonus will not apply.
SupportRageforgedPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意你使用或触发的伤害性技能，使其消耗怒火以造成更高伤害。如果你没有足够的怒火可供消耗，伤害加成不会生效。

SupportRageforgedPlayerTwo.en: Supports any damaging skill that you use or Trigger yourself, causing it to spend Rage to deal more damage, with a chance to skip spending Rage while still benefitting as though it had. If you don't have enough Rage to spend, the damage bonus will not apply.
SupportRageforgedPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助任意你使用或触发的伤害性技能，使其消耗怒火以造成更高伤害，有几率不消耗怒火仍然视为消耗并得到增益。如果你没有足够的怒火可供消耗，伤害加成不会生效。

SupportRagingCryPlayer.en: Supports Warcry skills, causing them to grant you Rage on use depending on counted monster Power.
SupportRagingCryPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助战吼技能，使你在使用时根据怪物的威力值而获得怒火。

SupportRakiatasFlowPlayer.en: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, causing those Hits to treat Enemy Elemental Resistances as inverted.
SupportRakiatasFlowPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可造成伤害性击中的技能，使击中将敌人的元素抗性视为反转。

SupportRapidAttacksPlayer.en: Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster.
SupportRapidAttacksPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助攻击，使攻击速度更快。

SupportRapidAttacksPlayerThree.en: Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster at the cost of Damage.
SupportRapidAttacksPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助攻击，使其攻击速度更快，但伤害降低。

SupportRapidAttacksPlayerTwo.en: Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster.
SupportRapidAttacksPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助攻击，使攻击速度更快。

SupportRapidCastingPlayer.en: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster.
SupportRapidCastingPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助法术，使施法速度加快。

SupportRapidCastingPlayerThree.en: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster for each different Spell you've cast in the last eight seconds.
SupportRapidCastingPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助法术，你过去 8 秒内每施放一种不同法术，施法速度就会加快。

SupportRapidCastingPlayerTwo.en: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster.
SupportRapidCastingPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助法术，使施法速度加快。

SupportRearmPlayer.en: Supports Skills which create Hazards. Hazards created by Supported Skills have a chance to be rearmed a short duration after triggering.
SupportRearmPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生危害的技能。被辅助技能产生的危害有几率在触发后的短时间里重新武装。

SupportRearmPlayerTwo.en: Supports Skills which create Hazards. Hazards created by Supported Skills have a chance to be rearmed a short duration after triggering.
SupportRearmPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助产生危害的技能。被辅助技能产生的危害有几率在触发后的短时间里重新武装。

SupportRefractionPlayer.en: Supports Banner Skills, causing those affected by Auras they create to gain Refractive Plating, a Buff which grants Deflection Rating and causes Armour to partially apply to Elemental Hit Damage.
SupportRefractionPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助旗帜技能，使受到其光环影响的目标获得折射镀层增益状态，提供偏转值，使一部分护甲能够对元素击中伤害生效。

SupportRefractionPlayerThree.en: Supports Banner Skills, causing Enemies within their area to gain Refractive Dissolution, a Debuff which lowers Elemental Resistances.
SupportRefractionPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助旗帜技能，使其范围内的敌人获得折射消散效果，该减益状态会降低元素抗性。

SupportRefractionPlayerTwo.en: Supports Banner Skills, causing those affected by Auras they create to gain Refractive Plating, a Buff which grants Deflection Rating and causes Armour to partially apply to Elemental Hit Damage.
SupportRefractionPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助旗帜技能，使受到其光环影响的目标获得折射镀层增益状态，提供偏转值，使一部分护甲能够对元素击中伤害生效。

SupportReinforcedTotemsPlayer.en: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by Supported Skills have additional Elemental Resistances.
SupportReinforcedTotemsPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生图腾的技能。被辅助技能产生的图腾具有额外的元素抗性。

SupportReinforcedTotemsPlayerTwo.en: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by Supported Skills have additional Elemental Resistances.
SupportReinforcedTotemsPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助产生图腾的技能。被辅助技能产生的图腾具有额外的元素抗性。

SupportRelentlessRagePlayer.en: Supports Skills you use yourself. On spending Rage with any skill you will gain a Buff. Using Supported Skills consumes this Buff to grant you Rage.
SupportRelentlessRagePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的技能，当你通过任何技能消耗怒火时，将获得一个增益状态。使用被辅助的技能会消耗此增益状态并为你提供怒火。

SupportRendingApexPlayer.en: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, causing the Final Strike to Break Armour based on a portion of Attack damage dealt.
SupportRendingApexPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可在连击结束时发动绝杀打击的打击技能，使该绝杀打击能基于所造成的攻击伤害的一部分使敌人护甲破损。

SupportRetaliatePlayer.en: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain much more damage the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.
SupportRetaliatePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用的近战攻击技能。你越接近重度晕眩状态，被辅助技能造成的伤害越高。

SupportRetaliatePlayerTwo.en: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain much more damage and are more capable of Stunning Enemies the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.
SupportRetaliatePlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用的近战攻击技能。你越接近重度晕眩状态，被辅助技能造成的伤害越高，晕眩敌人的能力越强。

SupportRetreatPlayer.en: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.
SupportRetreatPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生投射物的技能。如果你在过去八秒内造成过近战击中，被辅助技能造成的投射物伤害会提高，但其本身无法造成近战伤害。

SupportRetreatPlayerThree.en: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last two seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.
SupportRetreatPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助产生投射物的技能。如果你在过去两秒内造成过近战击中，被辅助技能造成的投射物伤害会提高，但其本身无法造成近战伤害。

SupportRetreatPlayerTwo.en: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.
SupportRetreatPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助产生投射物的技能。如果你在过去八秒内造成过近战击中，被辅助技能造成的投射物伤害会提高，但其本身无法造成近战伤害。

SupportReveberatePlayer.en: Supports Slam Skills. Supported Skills that have a chance to Aftershock have increased chance to cause Aftershocks the longer their Attack time.
SupportReveberatePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助猛击技能。被辅助技能拥有余震几率时，其攻击时间越长，造成余震的几率越高。

SupportRicochetPlayer.en: Supports any Skill which creates Projectiles, giving those Projectiles a chance to Chain when impacting terrain.
SupportRicochetPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生投射物的技能，使投射物击中地形时有几率连锁。

SupportRicochetPlayerTwo.en: Supports any Skill which creates Projectiles, giving those Projectiles a chance to Chain when impacting terrain.
SupportRicochetPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助产生投射物的技能，使投射物击中地形时有几率连锁。

SupportRigwaldsFerocityPlayer.en: Supports Attack skills, granting them Attack Speed at the cost of Damage or Damage at the cost of Attack Speed depending on Weapon Set they are used in. Does not modify skills used by Minions.
SupportRigwaldsFerocityPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助攻击技能，根据使用的武器组，以伤害为代价提供攻击速度，或以攻击速度为代价提供伤害。不会修改召唤生物使用的技能。

SupportRipPlayer.en: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use or Trigger yourself. Killing Blows with Supported Skills on Bleeding enemies create a Blood Remnant. Blood Remnants increase your Life regeneration rate for a short while after being collected.
SupportRipPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你使用或你自己触发的近战攻击技能。被辅助技能对流血的敌人造成最后一击会产生一个赤色残片。收集赤色残片会在短时间里提高你的生命回复速度。

SupportRitualisticCursePlayer.en: Supports Curse skills, causing them to cover a larger area but take longer to Curse enemies.
SupportRitualisticCursePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助诅咒技能，使其诅咒更大范围的敌人，但需要更长的生效时间。

SupportRomirasRequitalPlayer.en: Supports Skills that create Companions which can be damaged. Minions created by Supported Skills take a portion of Hit Damage you would otherwise have taken, but have lowered maximum Life. A percentage of Damage taken this way is Recouped by you as Life.
SupportRomirasRequitalPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生能够受到伤害的伙伴的技能。被辅助技能产生的召唤生物会替你承担一定比例的击中伤害，但其生命上限降低。以此方式受到的一部分伤害会吸纳为你的生命。

SupportRupturePlayer.en: Supports skills that Hit Enemies. Supported skills Aggravate Bleeding on Hitting Heavily Stunned Enemies.
SupportRupturePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助击中敌人的技能。被辅助技能击中重度晕眩的敌人时使流血效果变为恶性。

SupportRustedSpikesPlayer.en: Supports Skills which deal Damage with Hits. When Supported Skills Pin an Enemy, they also Aggravate Bleeding on that Enemy.
SupportRustedSpikesPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助能够击中敌人并造成伤害的技能。被辅助技能使敌人定身时，还会使利刃受到的流血变为恶性。

SupportSacrificalOfferingPlayer.en: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills Sacrifice a portion of your life on use, but deal much more damage and have more powerful Buffs in return.
SupportSacrificalOfferingPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助奉献技能。使用被辅助的技能会使你牺牲一部分生命，但造成的伤害大幅提高，并且产生更强大的增益状态。

SupportSacrificialLambPlayer.en: Supports Skills which create Minions, causing your Skills which can target Minions to prioritise targeting Minions from the Supported Skill before your other Minions where possible.
SupportSacrificialLambPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助能够产生召唤生物的技能，使你以召唤生物为目标的技能，优先选中被辅助技能产生的召唤生物，而非其他召唤生物。

SupportSacrificialLambPlayerTwo.en: Supports Skills which create Minions, causing your Skills which can target Minions to prioritise targeting Minions from the Supported Skill before your other Minions where possible, as well as causing them to always be considered Detonatable.
SupportSacrificialLambPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助能够产生召唤生物的技能，使你以召唤生物为目标的技能，优先选中被辅助技能产生的召唤生物，而非其他召唤生物，并使其总是被视为可引爆的。

SupportSalvoPlayer.en: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which fire Projectiles, Sealing them over time. The Seals are broken when used, causing additional Projectiles to be fired. Projectiles from Supported Skills are fired in random directions. Cannot Support Skills which require Combo, have a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.
SupportSalvoPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的发射投射物的攻击技能，使其随时间获得封印。使用时打破封印，发射额外投射物。来自被辅助技能的投射物会向随机方向发射。无法辅助需要连击、有冷却时间或能获得封印的技能。

SupportSecondWindPlayer.en: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.
SupportSecondWindPlayer.zh_cn:
辅助有冷却时间的技能，使其获得额外的冷却时间使用次数。
无法辅助非凡技能、瞬发技能或触发技能。不能调整召唤生物技能。

SupportSecondWindPlayerThree.en: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown and causing them to recover your Life when a Skill is used and goes on cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.
SupportSecondWindPlayerThree.zh_cn:
辅助有冷却时间的技能，使其获得额外的冷却时间使用次数，在技能被使用并进入冷却时为你回复生命。
无法辅助非凡技能、瞬发技能或触发技能。不能调整召唤生物技能。

SupportSecondWindPlayerTwo.en: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.
SupportSecondWindPlayerTwo.zh_cn:
辅助有冷却时间的技能，使其获得额外的冷却时间使用次数。
无法辅助非凡技能、瞬发技能或触发技能。不能调整召唤生物技能。

SupportSelflessRemnantsPlayer.en: Supports Skills that generate Remnants, causing those Remnants to affect Allies in your Presence when collected instead of you.
SupportSelflessRemnantsPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生残片的技能，收集残片时使其影响在场的友军，但不影响你。

SupportShockConductionPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to also Shock nearby enemies when you Shock an enemy.
SupportShockConductionPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，令敌人感电时有几率使附近的敌人感电。

SupportShockConductionPlayerTwo.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to also Shock nearby enemies when you Shock an enemy. Always Shocks enemies which are Drenched.
SupportShockConductionPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，令敌人感电时有几率使附近的敌人感电。对处于浸湿状态的敌人则必定施加感电。

SupportShockPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Shock.
SupportShockPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其更有可能造成感电。

SupportShockingLeapPlayer.en: Supports Skills that leap into the air and deal damage, causing them to create Shocked Ground the first time they Critically Hit an enemy.
SupportShockingLeapPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助会跳跃并造成伤害的技能，使其在第一次对敌人造成暴击时制造感电地面。

SupportShockingRiftPlayer.en: Supports Skills that Hit enemies. When Supported Skills Shock an enemy that is nearby other Shocked enemies, trigger Electromagnetism, sucking in nearby enemies, Hindering them, and dealing Lightning damage at an interval.
SupportShockingRiftPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可击中敌人的技能。使用被辅助的技能对敌人施加感电时，且该敌人周围存在其他感电敌人时，将触发电磁力场，使附近敌人缓速并将其吸入中心，以固定间隔造成闪电伤害。

SupportShortFusePlayer.en: Supports Skills which Detonate after some amount of time has elapsed, shortening the time before Detonation.
SupportShortFusePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助经过一定时间后引爆的技能，缩短引爆前的时间。

SupportShortFusePlayerTwo.en: Supports Skills which Detonate after some amount of time has elapsed, massively shortening the time before Detonation at the cost of Damage.
SupportShortFusePlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助经过一定时间后引爆的技能，大幅缩短引爆前的时间，但会牺牲伤害。

SupportSkitteringStonePlayer.en: Supports Skills which create shatterable earthen objects. After killing enough Enemies in range of these objects, they will shatter, releasing skittering stone Minions.
SupportSkitteringStonePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生可破坏土质物体的技能。在这些物体范围内击败足够敌人后，它们会破碎，释放出飞掠石召唤生物。

SupportSkitteringStonePlayerTwo.en: Supports Skills which create shatterable earthen objects. After killing enough Enemies in range of these objects, they will shatter, releasing skittering stone Minions.
SupportSkitteringStonePlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助产生可破坏土质物体的技能。在这些物体范围内击败足够敌人后，它们会破碎，释放出飞掠石召唤生物。

SupportSlamAftershocksPlayer.en: Supports Slams you use yourself, causing them to create simultaneous Aftershocks behind the Slam, but lowering Aftershock damage and area of effect with Supported Skills. Cannot Support Skills which create Fissures.
SupportSlamAftershocksPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的猛击，使其在猛击后同时产生一道余震，但会降低被辅助技能的余震伤害与影响范围。无法辅助会产生裂缝的技能。

SupportSlowPotencyPlayer.en: Supports any skill, causing inflicted Slows to be more powerful.
SupportSlowPotencyPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意技能，使其造成的减速效果更为强劲。

SupportSparPlayer.en: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills are more capable of Stunning Enemies the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.
SupportSparPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助近战攻击技能。你距离重度晕眩状态越近，被辅助技能使敌人晕眩的能力越强。

SupportSpectralVolleyPlayer.en: Supports Bow or Spear Projectile Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills deal lower damage initially, but generate Spectral Projectiles, which deal more damage when they fire. Spectral Projectiles linger and will fire a short duration after no new Spectral Projectiles have been created. Cannot support Channelling Skills, Leaping skills, or skills which rain Projectiles from above.
SupportSpectralVolleyPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用的弓类或战矛投射物攻击。被辅助技能造成的初始伤害降低，但会产生灵体投射物，发射时能造成更高的伤害。灵体投射物会持续保留，并在不再产生新的灵体投射物后的短时间内发射。无法辅助持续吟唱技能、跳跃技能，以及使投射物从天而降的技能。

SupportSpellCascadePlayer.en: Supports Cascadable Spells, causing them to Cascade to either side of the target area, along a randomly chosen axis.
SupportSpellCascadePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可扩散法术，使其沿随机选择的轴向目标区域两侧扩散。

SupportSpellEchoPlayer.en: Supports Cascadable Spells you use yourself. Supported Spells Echo.
SupportSpellEchoPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你自身使用的可扩散 法术。被辅助的法术产生法术 回响。

SupportSplinteringTotemPlayer.en: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing having more than one active Totem but causing that Totem to splinter into smaller versions of itself after it uses an Attack or Spell, with each Totem becoming less effective. Each splintered Totem can further splinter, up to a maximum. Does not Support Skills used by Minions. Only one Totem can be splintering at a time.
SupportSplinteringTotemPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可创建图腾的技能，但仅允许存在一个激活的图腾。该图腾在使用攻击或法术后会分裂为若干小型分身，且每个分裂出来的图腾效果会减弱。分裂产生的图腾可继续分裂，直至达到最大分裂次数。无法辅助由召唤生物施放的技能。同一时间仅能有一个图腾处于分裂状态。

SupportSplinteringTotemPlayerTwo.en: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing having more than one active Totem but causing that Totem to splinter into smaller versions of itself after it uses an Attack or Spell, with each Totem becoming less effective. Each splintered Totem can further splinter, up to a maximum. Does not Support Skills used by Minions. Only one Totem can be splintering at a time.
SupportSplinteringTotemPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助可创建图腾的技能，但仅允许存在一个激活的图腾。该图腾在使用攻击或法术后会分裂为若干小型分身，且每个分裂出来的图腾效果会减弱。分裂产生的图腾可继续分裂，直至达到最大分裂次数。无法辅助由召唤生物施放的技能。同一时间仅能有一个图腾处于分裂状态。

SupportStaticShocksPlayer.en: Supports Skills which can Hit enemies. Shocking an enemy with Hits from Supported Skills Triggers Static Shocks, causing that enemy to become a source of Lightning damage sending pulses towards nearby enemies.
SupportStaticShocksPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可击中敌人的技能。使用被辅助的技能击中并使敌人感电，会触发静电脉冲，使该敌人成为一个闪电伤害源，向附近的敌人释放脉冲。

SupportSteadfastPlayer.en: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, granting you higher Stun Threshold while Channelling them.
SupportSteadfastPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用的持续吟唱技能，使你在吟唱期间提高晕眩阈值。

SupportSteadfastPlayerTwo.en: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, granting you higher Stun Threshold and Ailment Threshold  while Channelling them.
SupportSteadfastPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用的持续吟唱技能，使你在吟唱期间提高晕眩阈值和异常状态阈值。

SupportStoicismPlayer.en: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills steadily gain more Damage, up to a cap. This Damage bonus is reset if you Dodge Roll or use a Travel Skill.
SupportStoicismPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用的攻击技能。被辅助的技能会逐渐获得更高伤害，直到达到上限。若你使用翻滚闪避或旅行技能，则该加成会重置。

SupportStoicismPlayerTwo.en: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills steadily gain more Damage, up to a cap. This Damage bonus is reset if you Dodge Roll or use a Travel Skill.
SupportStoicismPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用的攻击技能。被辅助的技能会逐渐获得更高伤害，直到达到上限。若你使用翻滚闪避或旅行技能，则该加成会重置。

SupportStompingGroundPlayer.en: Supports Travel skills, causing your footsteps to crack the earth and emit damaging shockwaves while using the skill.
SupportStompingGroundPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助旅行技能，使用该技能时，你的脚步会震裂大地并发出伤害性的冲击波。

SupportStormchainPlayer.en: Supports Projectile Skills and Skills which can Chain. Supported Skills always Chain when initially Hitting a Shocked Enemy, but cannot themselves inflict Shock. Does not support Skills which cannot Chain.
SupportStormchainPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助投射物技能和可以连锁的技能。被辅助技能第一次击中感电的敌人时必定连锁，但自身无法施加感电。无法辅助不能连锁的技能。

SupportStormfirePlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies. Enemies Shocked by Supported Skills take a percentage of damage from Ignite as Lightning damage as well as Fire damage.
SupportStormfirePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意可击中敌人的技能，被辅助技能感电的敌人，其受到的点燃伤害将有一部分额外转化为闪电伤害和火焰伤害。

SupportStreamlinedRoundsPlayer.en: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills. Supported Skills have significantly higher Attack speed and bolt capacity, but deal less damage and have longer reload time.
SupportStreamlinedRoundsPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助战弩弹药技能。被辅助技能的攻击速度和弩箭容量大幅提高，但伤害降低，装填时间延长。

SupportStrongHeartedPlayer.en: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Shock applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.
SupportStrongHeartedPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助永久性增益状态技能，激活被辅助技能时，缩短对你施加的感电的持续时间。

SupportStunPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to build up Stun more quickly.
SupportStunPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其积蓄晕眩的速度更快。

SupportStunPlayerThree.en: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to build up Stun significantly more quickly, at the cost of Damage.
SupportStunPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其积蓄晕眩的速度大幅加快，但会牺牲伤害。

SupportStunPlayerTwo.en: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to build up Stun more quickly.
SupportStunPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其积蓄晕眩的速度更快。

SupportSwiftAfflictionPlayer.en: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing it to deal more non-Ailment damage over time but have a shorter duration.
SupportSwiftAfflictionPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意造成伤害的技能，使其造成更高的非异常状态持续伤害，但缩短持续时间。

SupportSwiftAfflictionPlayerThree.en: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing effects with a duration of one second or less to deal more non-Ailment damage over time.
SupportSwiftAfflictionPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助任意造成伤害的技能，使持续时间为一秒或更短的效果造成更高的非异常状态持续伤害。

SupportSwiftAfflictionPlayerTwo.en: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing it to deal more non-Ailment damage over time but have a shorter duration.
SupportSwiftAfflictionPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助任意造成伤害的技能，使其造成更高的非异常状态持续伤害，但缩短持续时间。

SupportSyzygyPlayer.en: Supports Slam Skills you use yourself. Hits from Supported Skills are considered Crushing Blows against Enemies which are both Ignited and Fully Armour Broken. Hits with Supported Skills that Heavily Stun Ignited and Fully Armour Broken Enemies will Intimidate them.
SupportSyzygyPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用的猛击技能。被辅助技能的击中对同时受到点燃和护甲完全破损的目标视作粉碎打击。被辅助技能使点燃和护甲完全破损的目标陷入重度晕眩的击中还会威吓他们。

SupportTacatisIrePlayer.en: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Poison inflicted with Supported Skills deals Damage faster the higher your Rage.
SupportTacatisIrePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可造成伤害性击中的技能。根据你的怒火数量，被辅助技能施加的中毒伤害生效更快。

SupportTasaliosRhythmPlayer.en: Supports Skills which have a benefit for Perfectly Timing their use. On successfully executing Perfect Timing with Supported Skills, gain Tasalio's Rhythm. Tasalio's Rhythm causes Supported Skills to deal more damage and have shorter Perfect Timing windows for each stack. Failing to execute any Perfect Timing (even with skills not supported by Tasalio's Rhythm) will remove all Tasalio's Rhythm on you.
SupportTasaliosRhythmPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助在完美时机使用能获得加成的技能。被辅助技能成功把握完美时机会获得塔萨里奥的律动。塔萨里奥的律动会使被辅助技能造成更多伤害，且每层律动都会缩短技能的完美时机判定窗口。未能把握完美时机（包括未受到塔萨里奥的律动辅助的技能）会移除你身上的所有塔萨里奥的律动。

SupportTearPlayer.en: Supports Melee Attacks you use or Trigger yourself. On-Kill effects caused by Killing Blows with Supported Skills on Bleeding enemies have a chance to occur twice.
SupportTearPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你使用或你自己触发的近战攻击。被辅助技能对流血的敌人造成最后一击产生的击败效果有几率生效两次。

SupportTecrodsRevengePlayer.en: Supports Skills that create Persistent Minions, causing those Minions to fight on when they are fatally wounded, dying after a duration. Minions from Supported Skills gain Soul Eater and a burst of speed on entering this state.
SupportTecrodsRevengePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助能够产生永久性召唤生物的技能，使召唤生物在受到致命伤害后仍会继续战斗，持续一段时间后才会死亡。被辅助技能召唤的召唤生物在进入此状态时，获得噬魂者和速度爆发。

SupportTempestuousTempoPlayer.en: Supports Skills which deal Damage, raising Elemental Damage dealt for each Skill used Recently of a different Elemental type. Cannot support Minion Skills.
SupportTempestuousTempoPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助造成伤害的技能，近期每使用一个不同的元素类型的技能，其造成的元素伤害提高。无法辅助召唤生物技能。

SupportThornskinPlayer.en: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Thorns Damage while the Supported Skill is active.
SupportThornskinPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助永久性增益状态技能，激活被辅助技能时，提高你造成的荆棘伤害。

SupportThornskinPlayerTwo.en: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Thorns Damage while the Supported Skill is active.
SupportThornskinPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助永久性增益状态技能，激活被辅助技能时，提高你造成的荆棘伤害。

SupportThrillOfTheKillPlayer.en: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Culling a Shocked enemy with Supported Skills infuses all of your Attacks with Lightning damage for a short time.
SupportThrillOfTheKillPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的击中敌人的技能。使用被辅助的技能终结感电状态的敌人时，将为你的所有攻击短暂附加闪电伤害。

SupportThrillOfTheKillPlayerTwo.en: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Culling a Shocked enemy with Supported Skills infuses all of your Attacks with Lightning damage and grants an increased chance to Shock for a short time.
SupportThrillOfTheKillPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的击中敌人的技能。使用被辅助的技能终结感电状态的敌人时，将为你的所有攻击短暂附加闪电伤害并提高感电几率。

SupportTirelessPlayer.en: Supports Warcry Skills. Attacks Empowered by Supported Skills have a chance not to lower the Empowerment count of Supported Skills when they are used.
SupportTirelessPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助战吼技能。被辅助技能强化的攻击使用时有几率不减少被辅助技能的强化次数。

SupportTulsStillnessPlayer.en: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Freeze Buildup.
SupportTulsStillnessPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可造成伤害性击中的技能，提供额外混沌伤害，使混沌伤害作用于冻结积蓄。

SupportUhtredAuguryPlayer.en: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them additional levels provided exactly two other supports are used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
SupportUhtredAuguryPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可升级的技能，在恰好有两个其他辅助宝石修改被辅助技能的情况下，提供额外等级。无法辅助没有等级的技能。

SupportUhtredExodusPlayer.en: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them many additional levels provided no other supports are used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
SupportUhtredExodusPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可升级的技能，在没有其他辅助宝石修改被辅助技能的情况下，提供大量额外等级。

SupportUhtredOmenPlayer.en: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them additional levels provided exactly one other support is used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
SupportUhtredOmenPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可升级的技能，在恰好有一个其他辅助宝石修改被辅助技能的情况下，提供额外等级。无法辅助没有等级的技能。

SupportUnderminePlayer.en: Supports Attack Skills. Supported Skills Consume Maim on hit, Breaking a percentage of the Maimed target's Armour in doing so. Supported Skills cannot themselves inflict Maim.
SupportUnderminePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助攻击技能。被辅助技能击中时消耗瘫痪，并粉碎被瘫痪目标一定百分比的护甲。被辅助技能自身无法施加致残。

SupportUnerringPowerPlayer.en: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. When Supported Attacks are Empowered, they have significantly lowered cost and raised Accuracy.
SupportUnerringPowerPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的攻击技能。被辅助的攻击被强化时，其消耗大幅降低，并且提高命中。

SupportUnleashPlayer.en: Supports Repeatable Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them over time. The Seals are broken when cast, each causing the Spell to Repeat. Cannot support skills with a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.
SupportUnleashPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你施放的可重复法术，使其随时间获得封印。施放时打破封印，每层封印使该法术重复一次。无法辅助有冷却时间的技能或能获得封印的技能。

SupportUntouchablePlayer.en: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, you gain increased Evasion Rating, with the increase scaling higher the longer the Attack time of the supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.
SupportUntouchablePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的攻击技能。使用被辅助技能时你的闪避值提高，被辅助技能的攻击时间越长该比例越高。无法辅助持续吟唱技能。

SupportUpheavalPlayer.en: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create an additional fissure at the cost of damage and speed.
SupportUpheavalPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助在地上产生裂缝的技能，使其产生一道额外的裂缝，但会牺牲伤害和攻击速度。

SupportUpheavalPlayerTwo.en: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional fissures at the cost of damage and speed.
SupportUpheavalPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助在地上产生裂缝的技能，使其产生额外的裂缝，但会牺牲伤害和攻击速度。

SupportUpwellingPlayer.en: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing your Minions to deal increased Damage while you are not on full Mana while the Supported Skill is active.
SupportUpwellingPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助永久性增益状态技能，激活被辅助技能且你的魔力未满时，提高你的召唤生物造成的伤害。

SupportUpwellingPlayerTwo.en: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing your Minions to deal increased Damage while you are not on full Mana while the Supported Skill is active.
SupportUpwellingPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助永久性增益状态技能，激活被辅助技能且你的魔力未满时，提高你的召唤生物造成的伤害。

SupportUrgentTotemsPlayer.en: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly.
SupportUrgentTotemsPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助放置图腾的技能，使技能放置图腾的速度大幅加快。

SupportUrgentTotemsPlayerThree.en: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly. Totems created by Supported Skills have increased Attack and Cast Speed.
SupportUrgentTotemsPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助放置图腾的技能，使技能放置图腾的速度大幅加快。图腾在被辅助技能创造后的短时间内提高攻击和施法速度。

SupportUrgentTotemsPlayerTwo.en: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly.
SupportUrgentTotemsPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助放置图腾的技能，使技能放置图腾的速度大幅加快。

SupportUruksSmeltingPlayer.en: Supports any skill, causing Armour Break it inflicts to be stronger. Fully Breaking Armour with Supported Skills permanently increases the Physical Damage taken by those affected, up to a cap.
SupportUruksSmeltingPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意技能，使其造成的护甲破损更强。被辅助技能完全粉碎护甲时，永久增加受影响目标受到的物理伤害，该效果有上限。

SupportUulNetolsEmbracePlayer.en: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Break Armour.
SupportUulNetolsEmbracePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可造成伤害性击中的技能，提供额外混沌伤害，使混沌伤害粉碎护甲。

SupportVanguardPlayer.en: Supports Shield Skills, causing you to gain Guard on Stunning Enemies with the Supported Skill.
SupportVanguardPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助盾牌技能，使你用被辅助技能晕眩敌人时获得防卫。

SupportVanguardPlayerTwo.en: Supports Shield Skills, causing you to gain Guard on Stunning Enemies with the Supported Skill.
SupportVanguardPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助盾牌技能，使你用被辅助技能晕眩敌人时获得防卫。

SupportVarashtasBlessingPlayer.en: Supports any Skill that can deal damage, causing it to deal more damage for each different Command Skill you have used in the past few seconds. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.
SupportVarashtasBlessingPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意可造成伤害的技能，根据你在过去几秒内使用过的不同命令技能的数量，提高其伤害。无法影响召唤生物的技能。

SupportVerglasPlayer.en: Supports Skills you use yourself which can Hit Enemies. Supported Skills Gain a percentage of their Damage as Cold Damage when you destroy Ice Crystals.
SupportVerglasPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用且能够击中敌人的技能。当你摧毁冰晶时，被辅助技能获得一定比例的冰霜伤害。

SupportVilentasPropulsionPlayer.en: Supports Spell Skills that fire Projectiles, causing increases and reductions to cast speed to also apply to Projectile speed.
SupportVilentasPropulsionPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助发射投射物的法术技能，对施法速度的加速与减缓也同样作用于投射物速度。

SupportVitalityPlayer.en: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain Life Regeneration while the Skill is active.
SupportVitalityPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助永久性增益技能，激活该技能时提高你的生命回复速度。

SupportVitalityPlayerTwo.en: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain Life Regeneration while the Skill is active.
SupportVitalityPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助永久性增益技能，激活该技能时提高你的生命回复速度。

SupportVolatilityPlayer.en: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills grant Volatility on Critical Hit.
SupportVolatilityPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用的造成伤害性击中的技能。被辅助技能暴击时产生无常。

SupportVolcanicEruptionPlayer.en: Supports Melee Strike Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills trigger Volcanic Eruption on Hit against Ignited Enemies.
SupportVolcanicEruptionPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你使用的近战打击技能。被辅助技能击中点燃的敌人时触发熔火喷发。

SupportVoltPlayer.en: Supports Projectile Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain Voltaic Charge as you move, up to a maximum. When used, Supported Skills expend that Charge to gain extra Lightning Damage.
SupportVoltPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你自己使用的投射物攻击技能。被辅助技能在你移动时获得电伏充能，最多积累到最大值。使用被辅助技能时消耗充能，获得额外的闪电伤害。

SupportVruunsInevitability.en: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills gain Combo when you successfully Strike Enemies with other Melee Attacks. Supported Skills expend their Combo when used, gaining more area of effect the higher Combo they had. Cannot support skills which already gain Combo. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.
SupportVruunsInevitability.zh_cn: 辅助近战 攻击技能。当你使用其他近战 攻击成功打击敌人时，被辅助技能获得连击。被辅助技能使用时花费连击数，使用时连击数越高，获得的效果区域越大。无法辅助能获得连击的技能。无法修改召唤生物的技能。

SupportWallFortressPlayer.en: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to be created in a circle instead but deal less Hit damage.
SupportWallFortressPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助产生一排墙体的技能，使其改为产生环形墙体，但造成的击中伤害降低。

SupportWallFortressPlayerTwo.en: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to be created in a circle instead but deal less Hit damage and have lowered Area of Effect.
SupportWallFortressPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助产生一排墙体的技能，使其改为产生环形墙体，但击中伤害降低，效果范围缩小。

SupportWarmbloodedPlayer.en: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Freeze applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.
SupportWarmbloodedPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助永久性增益状态技能，激活被辅助技能时，缩短对你施加的冻结的持续时间。

SupportWildfirePlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, Spreading Ignites it inflicts to nearby enemies after a delay.
SupportWildfirePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其在一段延迟后将造成的点燃传播给附近的敌人。

SupportWildshardsPlayer.en: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have a chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle.
SupportWildshardsPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助投射物法术。被辅助法术有几率额外环形发射大量投射物。

SupportWildshardsPlayerThree.en: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have an increasingly higher chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle, resetting when they do.
SupportWildshardsPlayerThree.zh_cn: 辅助投射物法术。被辅助法术额外环形发射大量投射物的几率越来越高，触发时重置几率。

SupportWildshardsPlayerTwo.en: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have a chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle.
SupportWildshardsPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助投射物法术。被辅助法术有几率额外环形发射大量投射物。

SupportWindowOfOpportunityPlayer.en: Supports Channelling skills that have special effects if released with Perfect Timing, causing them to deal much more damage if released with Perfect Timing but reducing the Perfect Timing window.
SupportWindowOfOpportunityPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助在完美时机释放能产生特殊效果的持续吟唱技能，使其在完美时机释放时造成更高伤害，但会缩短完美时机的窗口。

SupportWindowOfOpportunityPlayerTwo.en: Supports Channelling skills that have special effects if released with Perfect Timing, causing them to deal much more damage and grant Perfect Deflection if released with Perfect Timing but reducing the Perfect Timing window.
SupportWindowOfOpportunityPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助在完美时机释放能产生特殊效果的持续吟唱技能，使其在完美时机释放时造成更高伤害并获得完美偏转，但会缩短完美时机的窗口。

SupportWitheringTouchPlayer.en: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Wither enemies on Hit.
SupportWitheringTouchPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使其击中敌人时有概率造成死亡凋零。

SupportXibaquasRendingPlayer.en: Supports Skills that leap into the air, causing Corpses in the area you land to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies.
SupportXibaquasRendingPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可跃向空中的技能。落地时，使你着陆区域内的灵柩猛烈爆炸，并对周围敌人造成伤害。

SupportXophsPyrePlayer.en: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Ignites.
SupportXophsPyrePlayer.zh_cn: 辅助可造成伤害性击中的技能，提供额外混沌伤害，使混沌伤害作用于点燃。

SupportZarokhsRefrainPlayer.en: Supports Cascadable Spells you cast yourself. Supported Spells Echo thrice, but are given a Cooldown. Cannot support skills which already have a Cooldown.
SupportZarokhsRefrainPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你自身施放的扩散 法术。被辅助的法术产生 3 次法术 回响，但会增加冷却时间。无法辅助有冷却时间的技能。

SupportZarokhsRevoltPlayer.en: Supports Repeatable Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them over time and giving them a moderate Cooldown. The Seals are broken when cast, each causing the Spell to Repeat. Cannot support skills which already have a Cooldown or gain seals.
SupportZarokhsRevoltPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你施放的可重复法术，使其随时间获得封印并增加一个适中的冷却时间。施放时打破封印，每层封印使该法术重复一次。无法辅助已有冷却时间或能获得封印的技能。

SupportZenithPlayer.en: Supports Spell Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage while you are above 90% of your Maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.
SupportZenithPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助法术技能。当你的魔力高于魔力上限的 90% 时，被辅助技能造成更高的伤害。不会修改召唤生物使用的技能。

SupportZenithPlayerTwo.en: Supports Spell Skills. Supported Skills have increased Mana cost Efficiency and deal more damage while you are above 90% of your maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.
SupportZenithPlayerTwo.zh_cn: 辅助法术技能。被辅助技能的魔力消耗效能提高，并且当你的魔力高于魔力上限的 90% 时，技能造成更高的伤害。不会修改召唤生物使用的技能。

SupportZerphisLegacyPlayer.en:
Supports Attacks and Warcries you use yourself. Supported Skills gain a Glory requirement, and build Glory when you spend Life on Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage and have significantly
 increased area of effect.
SupportZerphisLegacyPlayer.zh_cn:
辅助你施放的攻击与战吼。被辅助的技能将需要消耗荣耀，并且当你在技能上消耗生命时会积攒荣耀。被辅助的技能会造成更多伤害，并显著
扩大影响范围。

ViciousHexSupportPlayer.en: Supports Curse skills you cast yourself, causing them to trigger Doom Blast on Cursed enemies when the Curse expires.
ViciousHexSupportPlayer.zh_cn: 辅助你施放的诅咒技能，使其在诅咒结束时对被被诅咒的敌人触发末日爆炸。
